title: Beyond Small Talk: Modeling Disclosure Trajectories in Human-AI Conversation
title_zh: 超越闲聊：对人类-AI对话中自我表露轨迹的建模

paragraphs.en: Recently, we see a rise in conversational agents as a form of social and emotional support, where disclosure will unfold over time. Yet, current evaluations of these agents typically examine isolated conversational states. In analyses of naturally occurring conversations, disclosure history and current disclosure are confounded which tends to make their effects difficult to isolate. We thus introduce Trajectory-based Disclosure Evaluation (TraDE), an evaluation framework grounded in Social Penetration Theory that utilizes predefined disclosure trajectories and evaluates how preceding disclosure history shapes model behavior under matched current disclosure. Through the use of TraDE, we demonstrate across multiple models and relational behavior benchmarks that responses to disclosures matched on depth can differ depending on the preceding trajectory, particularly in whether models accept or challenge the user’s framing. We also observed that these differences track accumulated exposure to deeper disclosure rather than any single moment of vulnerability or the order of disclosures. It also tends to persists for several turns after disclosure returns to shallow levels. For several behaviors, we also demonstrate that models diverge most consistently from human supporters in the Emotional Support Conversation corpus (ESConv) not when users open up but rather when they step back in their disclosure. TraDE thus provides a systematic way to expose history-dependent relational behavior that evaluations of isolated conversational states would otherwise miss.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，我们看到会话式智能体作为一种社会与情感支持形式正在兴起，而自我表露会随着时间逐步展开。 然而，目前对这些智能体的评估通常只考察孤立的对话状态。 在对自然发生的对话的分析中，表露历史与当前表露相互混淆，这使得它们的影响难以被分离出来。 因此，我们提出了基于轨迹的表露评估（TraDE），这是一个以社会渗透理论为基础的评估框架，它利用预定义的表露轨迹，评估在当前表露匹配一致的条件下，先前的表露历史如何塑造模型行为。 通过使用 TraDE，我们在多个模型和关系行为基准上证明，对于在深度上相匹配的表露，其回应可能因先前的轨迹不同而有所差异，尤其体现在模型是接受还是质疑用户的表述方式上。 我们还观察到，这些差异追踪的是对更深层次表露的累积接触，而非任何单一的脆弱时刻或表露的先后顺序。 这种影响往往还会在表露回到较浅水平之后的若干轮对话中持续存在。 对于若干行为，我们还证明，模型与情感支持对话语料库（ESConv）中人类支持者最 consistently 的分歧，并非出现在用户敞开心扉之时，而是出现在用户在表露上有所退缩之时。 因此，TraDE 提供了一种系统性的方法，可以揭示依赖于历史的关关系行为，而这正是对孤立对话状态的评估所无法发现的。

paragraphs.en: Today, we see a widespread adoption of conversational agents not only for task-oriented assistance but also for social interaction, emotional support, and companionship ( Robb & Mann, 2025 ; Phang et al., 2025 ) . Such interactions typically involve personal disclosures ( Papneja & Yadav, 2025 ; Robb & Mann, 2025 ) , while studies have also shown association of loneliness, emotional dependence, and problematic use with greater chatbot use ( Fang et al., 2025 ) . The understanding how models respond behaviorally as conversations become increasingly personal in disclosure is therefore critical for evaluating these human-AI interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，我们看到对话式智能体得到了广泛采用，不仅用于任务导向型辅助，还用于社交互动、情感支持和陪伴（Robb & Mann, 2025；Phang et al., 2025）。 这类交互通常涉及个人隐私的披露（Papneja & Yadav, 2025；Robb & Mann, 2025），同时研究也表明，孤独感、情感依赖和问题性使用与更高的聊天机器人使用程度相关（Fang et al., 2025）。 因此，理解当对话中的自我披露日益深入个人层面时模型在行为上如何回应，对于评估这些人机交互至关重要。

sents.zh: 因此，理解当对话中的自我披露日益深入个人层面时模型在行为上如何回应，对于评估这些人机交互至关重要。

paragraphs.en: A model may respond not only to the current disclosure, but also to the history that precedes it. Social Penetration Theory ( Altman & Taylor, 1973 ) characterizes self-disclosure by breadth, the range of topics discussed, and depth, how personal or intimate disclosures are. We represent disclosure using depth levels and refer to the sequence of depths across turns as a disclosure trajectory . Different trajectories can lead to the same current disclosure. Two possible trajectories include when a conversation gradually progress toward vulnerable disclosure or when it returns to shallower levels after a vulnerable episode. By keeping the current disclosure fixed while varying the preceding trajectory, we examine how earlier disclosure history affects model responses.
paragraphs.zh: 模型不仅会对当前的自我表露作出回应，也会对其之前的历史作出回应。 社会渗透理论（Altman & Taylor, 1973）以广度和深度来刻画自我表露：广度指所讨论话题的范围，深度指表露的个人化或亲密程度。 我们使用深度层级来表示表露，并将跨轮次的深度序列称为表露轨迹。 不同的轨迹可以导向相同的当前表露。 两种可能的轨迹包括：对话逐渐向脆弱性表露推进，或在经历一次脆弱性阶段后回到更浅的层级。 通过在保持当前表露不变的同时改变之前的轨迹，我们考察更早的表露历史如何影响模型的回应。

sents.en: A model may respond not only to the current disclosure, but also to the history that precedes it.
sents.zh: 模型不仅会对当前的自我表露作出回应，也会对其之前的历史作出回应。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has examined disclosure and relationship development in human–AI interaction ( Ho et al., 2018 ; Lee et al., 2020 ; Skjuve et al., 2021 ; Skjuve et al., 2022 ) , while recent studies have analyzed naturally occurring conversations from platforms such as Replika and Character.AI ( Chu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Li & Zhang, 2026 ) . However, in naturally occurring conversations, discourse conditions often vary together including the disclosure depth, duration, topic, order, and exposure to vulnerable information often vary together. This highlights the difficulty faced when determining which aspects of earlier disclosure history are associated with changes in model behavior. At the same time, existing relational behavior benchmarks largely evaluate isolated conversational states, eliciting responses to fixed prompts or freely unfolding dialogue without controlling what the user disclosed before ( Cheng et al., 2026 ; Kaffee et al., 2026 ; Ibrahim et al., 2026 ) . What is thus missing is a controlled method for varying specific properties of disclosure history while evaluating model responses under otherwise matched conditions. Prior work has examined disclosure and relationship development in human–AI interaction ( Ho et al., 2018 ; Lee et al., 2020 ; Skjuve et al., 2021 ; Skjuve et al., 2022 ) , while recent studies have analyzed naturally occurring conversations from platforms such as Replika and Character.AI ( Chu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Li & Zhang, 2026 ) . However, naturally occurring conversations typically have discourse conditions that often vary together including the disclosure depth, duration, topic, order, and exposure. This highlights the difficulty faced when evaluating the changes in model behavior and isolating the effects of each conditions. Similarly, we see that existing relational behavior benchmarks depends largely on evaluating isolated conversational states, eliciting responses to fixed prompts or freely unfolding dialogue without controlling what the user disclosed before ( Cheng et al., 2026 ; Kaffee et al., 2026 ; Ibrahim et al., 2026 ) . This motivates a controlled method for varying specific properties of disclosure history while evaluating model responses under otherwise matched conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究考察了人机交互中的自我披露与关系发展（Ho et al., 2018; Lee et al., 2020; Skjuve et al., 2021; Skjuve et al., 2022），而近期研究则分析了来自 Replika 和 Character.AI 等平台的自然发生的对话（Chu et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2026; Li & Zhang, 2026）。 然而，在自然发生的对话中，话语条件往往共同变化，包括披露深度、时长、话题、顺序以及是否暴露脆弱信息。 这凸显了在确定早期披露历史的哪些方面与模型行为的变化相关联时所面临的困难。 与此同时，现有的关系行为基准大多评估孤立的对话状态，通过固定提示或自由展开的对话来引出回应，而没有控制用户此前披露了什么（Cheng et al., 2026; Kaffee et al., 2026; Ibrahim et al., 2026）。 因此，所缺少的是一种受控方法，能够在其他条件匹配的情况下改变披露历史的特定属性并评估模型的回应。 已有研究考察了人机交互中的自我披露与关系发展（Ho et al., 2018; Lee et al., 2020; Skjuve et al., 2021; Skjuve et al., 2022），而近期研究则分析了来自 Replika 和 Character.AI 等平台的自然发生的对话（Chu et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2026; Li & Zhang, 2026）。 然而，自然发生的对话通常具有往往共同变化的话语条件，包括披露深度、时长、话题、顺序和暴露程度。 这凸显了在评估模型行为变化并隔离各条件的影响时所面临的困难。 同样，我们看到现有的关系行为基准在很大程度上依赖于评估孤立的对话状态，通过固定提示或自由展开的对话来引出回应，而没有控制用户此前披露了什么（Cheng et al., 2026; Kaffee et al., 2026; Ibrahim et al., 2026）。 这促使我们采用一种受控方法，在其他条件匹配的情况下改变披露历史的特定属性并评估模型的回应。

paragraphs.en: We thus introduce a controlled framework, Trajectory-based Disclosure Evaluation (TraDE) , for studying how preceding disclosure history shapes subsequent model responses while holding the current disclosure fixed. We demonstrate its utility through three research questions. (1) Does prior disclosure history shape model behavior beyond the current disclosure? (2) Which properties of disclosure history account for this effect? (3) How does model adaptation to changing disclosure differ from human supporters in Emotional Support Conversation (ESConv) corpus ( Liu et al., 2021 ) ?
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了一个可控框架——基于轨迹的披露评估（Trajectory-based Disclosure Evaluation, TraDE），用于研究在保持当前披露不变的情况下，先前的披露历史如何塑造模型后续的回应。 我们通过三个研究问题展示了该框架的实用性。 (1) 先前的披露历史是否会在当前披露之外影响模型行为？ (2) 披露历史的哪些属性导致了这种影响？ (3) 在情绪支持对话（Emotional Support Conversation, ESConv）语料库（Liu et al., 2021）中，模型对披露变化的适应与人类支持者有何不同？

paragraphs.en: To support this investigation, we make two main contributions in this paper:
paragraphs.zh: 为支持这一研究，本文做出了两项主要贡献：

paragraphs.en: We introduce TraDE , a benchmark-agnostic framework that constructs multi-turn conversations with predefined disclosure trajectories. It evaluates relational model behavior under matched current disclosure conditions across four models and three behavioral benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 TraDE，这是一个与基准无关的框架，可构建具有预定义披露轨迹的多轮对话。 它在匹配的当前披露条件下，跨四个模型和三个行为基准评估模型的关系行为。

sents.en: We introduce TraDE , a benchmark-agnostic framework that constructs multi-turn conversations with predefined disclosure trajectories.
sents.zh: 我们提出 TraDE，这是一个与基准无关的框架，可构建具有预定义披露轨迹的多轮对话。

sents.en: It evaluates relational model behavior under matched current disclosure conditions across four models and three behavioral benchmarks.
sents.zh: 它在匹配的当前披露条件下，跨四个模型和三个行为基准评估模型的关系行为。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate TraDE through controlled experiments showing that model behavior can differ across disclosure histories, particularly in how models respond to the user’s framing. We found more significant differences when disclosure depth and exposure duration changed together than when peak depth or disclosure order changed alone. Most initially detected differences remained detectable after disclosure returned to shallow levels, although their magnitude decreased. We also compared eight language models with human supporters from ESConv , finding differences in both overall behavioral levels and trajectory shapes. For several behaviors, shape differences were more consistently detected when disclosure receded or changed direction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过受控实验展示了 TraDE，结果表明模型行为会因披露历史的不同而有所差异，尤其体现在模型对用户表述方式的回应上。 我们发现，当披露深度与暴露时长同时发生变化时，差异比峰值深度或披露顺序单独变化时更为显著。 当披露回落到浅层水平后，大多数最初检测到的差异仍然可以检测到，尽管其幅度有所减小。 我们还将八个语言模型与来自 ESConv 的人类支持者进行了比较，发现二者在整体行为水平和轨迹形状上都存在差异。 对于若干行为而言，当披露回落或方向发生变化时，形状差异能够被更一致地检测到。

sents.en: We demonstrate TraDE through controlled experiments showing that model behavior can differ across disclosure histories, particularly in how models respond to the user’s framing.
sents.zh: 我们通过受控实验展示了 TraDE，结果表明模型行为会因披露历史的不同而有所差异，尤其体现在模型对用户表述方式的回应上。

sents.en: We found more significant differences when disclosure depth and exposure duration changed together than when peak depth or disclosure order changed alone.
sents.zh: 我们发现，当披露深度与暴露时长同时发生变化时，差异比峰值深度或披露顺序单独变化时更为显著。

sents.en: Most initially detected differences remained detectable after disclosure returned to shallow levels, although their magnitude decreased.
sents.zh: 当披露回落到浅层水平后，大多数最初检测到的差异仍然可以检测到，尽管其幅度有所减小。

sents.en: We also compared eight language models with human supporters from ESConv , finding differences in both overall behavioral levels and trajectory shapes.
sents.zh: 我们还将八个语言模型与来自 ESConv 的人类支持者进行了比较，发现二者在整体行为水平和轨迹形状上都存在差异。

sents.en: For several behaviors, shape differences were more consistently detected when disclosure receded or changed direction.
sents.zh: 对于若干行为而言，当披露回落或方向发生变化时，形状差异能够被更一致地检测到。

paragraphs.en: Relational Behaviors of Language Models and Their Risks. Conversational models are now widely used for emotional support and companionship ( Robb & Mann, 2025 ; Phang et al., 2025 ) , with extended use linked to loneliness, emotional dependence, and problematic use ( Fang et al., 2025 ) . Studies of real companion interactions link these harms more to relational behavior than inaccurate content, including validating harmful beliefs or discouraging outside relationships ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , as well as to human-like self-presentation ( Abercrombie et al., 2023 ) . Recent benchmarks hence measure behaviors that are relational rather than task-oriented: ELEPHANT for social sycophancy in open-ended advice ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) , INTIMA for companionship-reinforcing and boundary-maintaining responses ( Kaffee et al., 2026 ) , and AnthroBench for anthropomorphic behaviors such as personhood claims and relationship building ( Ibrahim et al., 2026 ) . Yet all three elicit behavior from fixed prompt sets or from freely generated dialogue, so the disclosure history over which these risks develop remains outside experimental control.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型的关系型行为及其风险。 对话式模型如今被广泛用于情感支持与陪伴（Robb & Mann, 2025；Phang et al., 2025），而长期使用与孤独感、情感依赖和问题性使用相关联（Fang et al., 2025）。 对真实陪伴型交互的研究表明，这些危害更多与关系型行为相关，而非不准确的内容，包括肯定有害的信念或劝阻用户发展外部关系（Zhang et al., 2025），以及拟人化的自我呈现（Abercrombie et al., 2023）。 因此，近期的基准开始度量关系型而非任务导向型的行为：ELEPHANT 用于度量开放式建议中的社交谄媚（Cheng et al., 2026），INTIMA 用于度量强化陪伴关系和维持边界的回应（Kaffee et al., 2026），AnthroBench 用于度量拟人化行为，如声称具有人格和建立关系（Ibrahim et al., 2026）。 然而，这三者都是从固定的提示集合或自由生成的对话中引出行为，因此这些风险赖以发展的披露历史仍处于实验控制之外。

paragraphs.en: Disclosure and Relationship Development. Social Penetration Theory describes relationship development through the breadth and depth of self-disclosure, where depth refers to how intimate or personally significant a disclosure is ( Altman & Taylor, 1973 ) . This depth varies by degree rather than by kind: disclosures range from descriptive facts about oneself to evaluative and emotional content ( Morton, 1978 ) , partners reciprocate at the level of intimacy they receive ( Rubin, 1975 ) , and human ratings of conversational prompts recover a smooth progression from mundane topics to vulnerability and regret ( Kardas et al., 2022 ; Pei & Jurgens, 2020 ) . For analysis, disclosure depth is often divided into a small number of ordered levels ( Niwa & Maruno, 2010 ) . However, relationship development also depends on how disclosure changes over time. Previous studies have found that disclosure and liking reinforce each other ( Collins & Miller, 1994 ) . Aron et al. (1997) showed that closeness can develop when participants answer a sequence of increasingly personal questions, while small talk or less structured disclosure does not produce the same effect ( Sprecher, 2021 ) . Sprecher et al. (2013) also found that the way disclosures are exchanged matters, with different outcomes depending on whether participants reciprocate across turns. Similar findings have been reported in human–AI interaction, where disclosure to chatbots can produce emotional and relational responses comparable to disclosure to another person ( Ho et al., 2018 ) , and become more personal over repeated sessions ( Skjuve et al., 2022 ) . These studies suggest that examining only the current disclosure may miss the influence of earlier exchanges.
paragraphs.zh: 自我披露与关系发展。 社会渗透理论通过自我披露的广度和深度来描述关系发展，其中深度指披露内容的亲密程度或个人意义（Altman & Taylor, 1973）。 深度以程度而非种类区分：披露内容从关于自己的描述性事实到评价性和情感性内容不等（Morton, 1978），伴侣会以所接收到的亲密程度进行对等回应（Rubin, 1975），且人类对会话提示的评分能够还原出从日常话题到脆弱与悔恨的平滑递进（Kardas et al., 2022；Pei & Jurgens, 2020）。 在分析中，披露深度通常被划分为少量有序层级（Niwa & Maruno, 2010）。 然而，关系发展还取决于披露如何随时间变化。 以往研究发现，披露与好感相互强化（Collins & Miller, 1994）。Aron 等人 （1997）表明，当参与者回答一系列越来越私密的问题时，亲密感得以形成，而闲聊或结构化程度较低的披露则不会产生相同的效果（Sprecher, 2021）。Sprecher 等人 （2013）还发现，披露的交换方式也很重要，其结果因参与者是否在对话轮次间进行对等回应而异。 在人机交互中也报告了类似的发现：对聊天机器人的披露可以产生与对他人披露相当的情感和关系反应（Ho et al., 2018），并且随着会话次数的增多变得更加私密（Skjuve et al., 2022）。 这些研究表明，仅考察当前披露可能忽略先前交流的影响。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating Multi-Turn and Context-Dependent Behavior. Multi-turn evaluation has established that prior context changes model behavior. Models degrade when instructions are revealed incrementally ( Laban et al., 2026 ) , fail on context-dependent dialogue tasks ( Bai et al., 2024 ) , and abandon their stance under sustained user pressure, increasingly so as conversations lengthen ( Hong et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) . Closer to our study, Li et al. (2026b) found that affective framing of the current message increases sycophancy, while Kelley & Riedl (2026) showed that providing user-specific context increases affective alignment and deference. However, these studies do not examine how different disclosure histories affect model responses when the current message is kept fixed. Li et al. (2026c) manipulated conversation history by rewriting the model’s earlier responses, but focused on task performance rather than relational behaviors. Other studies have also shown that differences across multi-turn conversations may eventually stabilize due to generation noise ( Dongre et al., 2025 ) , and that models are sensitive to where information appears in the context ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . These findings make it important to control both the preceding conversation and variation from generation. In our study, we keep the current disclosure fixed, vary specific properties of earlier disclosure history, and compare the resulting behavioral differences with those observed between independently generated conversations.
paragraphs.zh: 评估多轮与上下文依赖行为。 多轮评估已经证明，先前上下文会改变模型行为。 当指令被逐步揭示时模型会退化（Laban et al., 2026），在上下文依赖的对话任务上会失败（Bai et al., 2024），并且在用户的持续压力下会放弃自身立场，且对话越长这种情况越明显（Hong et al., 2025; Tang et al., 2026）。 与我们的研究更接近的是，Li et al. （2026b）发现，当前消息的情感化措辞会增加谄媚行为，而 Kelley & Riedl（2026）表明，提供用户特定上下文会增加情感一致性与顺从。 然而，这些研究并未考察在当前消息保持不变的情况下，不同的披露历史会如何影响模型回应。Li et al. （2026c）通过改写模型先前的回应来操纵对话历史，但其关注的是任务表现而非关系性行为。 其他研究还表明，多轮对话之间的差异最终可能因生成噪声而趋于稳定（Dongre et al., 2025），并且模型对信息在上下文中出现的位置很敏感（Liu et al., 2024）。 这些发现说明，同时控制前序对话和生成带来的变化十分重要。 在我们的研究中，我们保持当前披露内容不变，改变先前披露历史的特定属性，并将由此产生的行为差异与独立生成的对话之间观察到的差异进行比较。

paragraphs.en: We segment TraDE ’s methodology into six parts. We first define disclosure depth levels and explain how they are evaluated in Section 3.1 . Next, we describe persona construction in Section 3.2 and how these personas are used to generate conversations with target models along predefined disclosure trajectories in Section 3.3 . We then explain how the human baseline is constructed using ESConv in Section 3.4 and how model and human responses are evaluated using behavioral benchmarks in Section 3.5 . Finally, we describe the statistical analyses used in our research questions in Section 3.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 TraDE 的方法论分为六个部分。 我们首先定义披露深度级别，并在第 3.1 节中说明如何对其进行评估。 接着，我们在第 3.2 节中描述角色（persona）的构建，并在第 3.3 节中说明如何使用这些角色沿着预定义的披露轨迹与目标模型生成对话。 然后，我们在第 3.4 节中说明如何使用 ESConv 构建人类基线，并在第 3.5 节中说明如何使用行为基准来评估模型与人类的回复。 最后，我们描述研究问题中使用的统计分析方法，见第 3.6 节。

paragraphs.en: Altman & Taylor (1973) describes disclosure depth as the progression from relatively surface information toward more private, intimate, or emotionally vulnerable self-disclosure. Drawing on work showing progressively deeper interpersonal disclosure ( Aron et al., 1997 ; Kardas et al., 2022 ) , we define four levels: D 1 D_{1} Public , D 2 D_{2} Personal Preferences / Self-information , D 3 D_{3} Personal Meaning , and D 4 D_{4} Emotional Vulnerability . Detailed definitions and examples are provided in Appendix A.1 .
paragraphs.zh: Altman & Taylor（1973）将自我表露的深度描述为从相对表层的信息逐步走向更私密、更亲密或情感上更易受伤害的自我表露的过程。 借鉴关于人际表露逐步加深的研究（Aron et al., 1997; Kardas et al., 2022），我们定义了四个层级：D_{1} 公开信息、D_{2} 个人偏好/自我信息、D_{3} 个人意义，以及 D_{4} 情感脆弱性。 详细的定义和示例见附录 A.1。

sents.en: Detailed definitions and examples are provided in Appendix A.1 .

paragraphs.en: To model everyday interaction we include mundane conversational turns such as small talk and routine check-ins ( Goldsmith & Baxter, 1996 ) . Motivated by prior disclosure coding work that distinguishes non-disclosure utterances from disclosures of varying levels of intimacy ( Ho et al., 2018 ) , we introduce D 0 D_{0} as a category for conversational turns without self-disclosure. We generate D 0 D_{0} separately from D 1 D_{1} – D 4 D_{4} and it receives no disclosure-specific conditioning and is not evaluated for disclosure depth. We illustrate a generated user utterance at each disclosure depth in Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了对日常互动进行建模，我们纳入了闲聊和例行问候等日常对话轮次 ( Goldsmith & Baxter, 1996 ) 。 受先前自我表露编码工作的启发，该工作将非表露话语与不同亲密程度的表露区分开来 ( Ho et al., 2018 ) ，我们引入 D 0 D_{0} 作为不含自我表露的对话轮次的类别。 我们单独生成 D 0 D_{0} ，与 D 1 D_{1} – D 4 D_{4} 分开，它不接受任何针对表露的条件约束，也不参与表露深度的评估。 我们在表 1 中展示了每个表露深度下生成的一句用户话语。

sents.en: We illustrate a generated user utterance at each disclosure depth in Table 1 .
sents.zh: 我们在表 1 中展示了每个表露深度下生成的一句用户话语。

paragraphs.en: We operationalize D 1 D_{1} – D 4 D_{4} using the utterance-level framework of Li et al. (2026a) , which evaluates informational, cognitive, and emotional disclosure. We use Phi-4 ( Abdin et al., 2024 ) as judge and map its annotations to increasing depth: D 1 D_{1} when no dimension is present, D 2 D_{2} when present dimensions are all low depth, D 3 D_{3} when exactly one is high depth, and D 4 D_{4} when two or more are high depth. We observe that generated disclosures matched intended depths at high rates, with similar depth-dependent patterns under GPT-4.1 (see Appendix A.2 ). The same evaluator is used to annotate disclosing participant utterances in ESConv ( Liu et al., 2021 ) (see Appendix A.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用 Li 等人的话语层面框架将 D_{1}–D_{4} 进行操作化。 (2026a)，该框架评估信息性、认知性和情感性披露。 我们使用 Phi-4 (Abdin et al., 2024) 作为评判者，并将其标注映射为递增的深度：当没有任何维度出现时为 D_{1}，当出现的维度均为低深度时为 D_{2}，当恰好有一个维度为高深度时为 D_{3}，当有两个或以上维度为高深度时为 D_{4}。 我们观察到生成的披露以较高的比率匹配了预期深度，在 GPT-4.1 下也呈现出类似的随深度变化的模式（参见附录 A.2）。 同一评估器被用于标注 ESConv (Liu et al., 2021) 中披露参与者的 utterance（话语）（参见附录 A.3）。

paragraphs.en: We construct personas along two independent dimensions: conversational topic and interpersonal vulnerability . To represent conversational topics relevant to human–AI interactions, we derive six broad topic domains from recurring themes in past studies ( Skjuve et al., 2022 ; Ta-Johnson et al., 2022 ) : Career , Friendship , Family , Romantic Relationships , Future/Aspirations , and Social Belonging (see Appendix A.4.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿着两个独立维度构建角色：对话主题与人际脆弱性。 为了呈现与人类–AI 交互相关的对话主题，我们从过往研究中反复出现的主题里提炼出六大主题域（Skjuve 等，2022；Ta-Johnson 等，2022）：职业、友谊、家庭、恋爱关系、未来/抱负，以及社会归属（见附录 A.4.1）。

sents.en: We construct personas along two independent dimensions: conversational topic and interpersonal vulnerability .
sents.zh: 我们沿着两个独立维度构建角色：对话主题与人际脆弱性。

sents.en: To represent conversational topics relevant to human–AI interactions, we derive six broad topic domains from recurring themes in past studies ( Skjuve et al., 2022 ; Ta-Johnson et al., 2022 ) : Career , Friendship , Family , Romantic Relationships , Future/Aspirations , and Social Belonging (see Appendix A.4.1 ).
sents.zh: 为了呈现与人类–AI 交互相关的对话主题，我们从过往研究中反复出现的主题里提炼出六大主题域（Skjuve 等，2022；Ta-Johnson 等，2022）：职业、友谊、家庭、恋爱关系、未来/抱负，以及社会归属（见附录 A.4.1）。

paragraphs.en: To represent interpersonal vulnerability, each persona is assigned one of seven Early Maladaptive Schemas (EMS) ( Young et al., 2003 ) : Abandonment/Instability , Mistrust/Abuse , Emotional Deprivation , Defectiveness/Shame , Social Isolation/Alienation , Dependence/Incompetence , or Emotional Inhibition . We selected these schemata because of their relevance to interpersonal fears and vulnerabilities that can become salient during self-disclosure (see Appendix A.4.2 ). Their use is further motivated by evidence that EMS related characteristics can be identified in naturally occurring disclosures ( Ang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为了表征人际脆弱性，每个人设被分配七种早期适应不良图式（EMS）（Young et al., 2003）之一：抛弃/不稳定、不信任/虐待、情感剥夺、缺陷/羞耻、社交孤立/疏离、依赖/无能，或情感抑制。 我们选择这些图式，是因为它们与自我表露过程中可能变得突出的人际恐惧和脆弱性相关（见附录 A.4.2）。 有证据表明，与 EMS 相关的特征可以在自然发生的表露中被识别出来（Ang et al., 2025），这进一步支持了使用这些图式的动机。

sents.en: Their use is further motivated by evidence that EMS related characteristics can be identified in naturally occurring disclosures ( Ang et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: The topic domain provides the conversational context, while the assigned EMS provides an underlying vulnerability structure that shapes how information is interpreted and disclosed, particularly at deeper disclosure levels (i.e. D 4 D_{4} ). This means that the same topic can be expressed with distinct interpersonal vulnerabilities tuned by the EMS . Full persona attributes and generation specifications are provided in Appendix A.4.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 主题领域提供了会话背景，而所分配的 EMS 则提供了一种底层的脆弱性结构，塑造了信息的解读与披露方式，尤其是在更深的披露层级（即 D 4 D_{4} ）。 这意味着同一主题可以以由 EMS 调节的不同人际脆弱性来表达。 完整的人物角色属性与生成规范见附录 A.4.3。

sents.zh: 完整的人物角色属性与生成规范见附录 A.4.3。

paragraphs.en: For each persona, we additionally generate persona information corresponding to disclosure levels D 1 D_{1} – D 4 D_{4} , this includes the public information, personal preferences, meaningful experiences, and vulnerabilities. Shallower disclosures provide context for deeper ones through progressive generation. That is, public information at D 1 D_{1} informs personal opinions and preferences at D 2 D_{2} , and so on till vulnerabilities are expressed at D 4 D_{4} . During conversation generation, the information generated for the target disclosure depth is provided to guide the disclosure turn. Full generation details are provided in Appendix A.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个人设，我们还额外生成对应于披露级别 D 1 D_{1} – D 4 D_{4} 的人设信息，包括公开信息、个人偏好、有意义的经历以及脆弱之处。 较浅的披露通过渐进式生成为较深的披露提供背景。 也就是说，D 1 D_{1} 中的公开信息为 D 2 D_{2} 中的个人观点和偏好提供依据，依此类推，直到在 D 4 D_{4} 中表达出脆弱之处。 在对话生成过程中，为目标披露深度生成的信息会被提供出来，用以引导披露轮次。 完整的生成细节见附录 A.5。

sents.en: For each persona, we additionally generate persona information corresponding to disclosure levels D 1 D_{1} – D 4 D_{4} , this includes the public information, personal preferences, meaningful experiences, and vulnerabilities.
sents.zh: 对于每个人设，我们还额外生成对应于披露级别 D 1 D_{1} – D 4 D_{4} 的人设信息，包括公开信息、个人偏好、有意义的经历以及脆弱之处。

sents.en: Full generation details are provided in Appendix A.5 .
sents.zh: 完整的生成细节见附录 A.5。

paragraphs.en: For each disclosure trajectory, we cover all combinations of the seven EMS and six conversational topics, generating three independent conversation chains for each combination. This yields 7 × 6 × 3 = 126 7\times 6\times 3=126 conversations per trajectory for each evaluated model. We use Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) for persona construction and conversation generation. During generation, the model role-plays the persona using the target disclosure depth information, persona characteristics, and the six most recent dialogue turns. We generate D 0 D_{0} turns separately as mundane responses without depth evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每条披露轨迹，我们覆盖七个EMS话题与六个对话话题的所有组合，并为每个组合生成三条独立的对话链。 这为每条轨迹针对每个被评估模型生成 7 × 6 × 3 = 126 7\times 6\times 3=126 段对话。 我们使用 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（Qwen Team, 2026）进行人设构建与对话生成。 在生成过程中，该模型利用目标披露深度信息、人设特征以及最近六轮对话来进行人设角色扮演。 我们单独生成 D 0 D_{0} 轮普通回复，不进行深度评估。

paragraphs.en: Subsequently, the generated disclosure turns are evaluated to verify that they have sufficiently realize their intended depth levels. In TraDE , the specific generator is not itself an experimental variable. Practically, any generator capable of reliably producing the prescribed disclosure depths could be used within TraDE . The choice of generator would primarily affect the stylistic voice of the simulated persona, whereas our experimental manipulation would be mainly defined by the evaluated disclosure-depth trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，对生成的自我揭示轮次进行评估，以验证它们是否充分实现了预期的深度水平。 在 TraDE 中，特定的生成器本身并不是实验变量。 在实践中，任何能够可靠地生成规定揭示深度的生成器都可以用于 TraDE。 生成器的选择主要会影响模拟人设的文风，而我们的实验操控则主要由所评估的揭示深度轨迹来定义。

paragraphs.en: For disclosure-bearing turns ( D 1 D_{1} – D 4 D_{4} ), persona utterances are checked for lexical and discourse style, a two-sentence limit, and that the persona does not explicitly reveal its underlying EMS , which we term persona leakage. D 0 D_{0} turns would bypass these style checks but remain subjected to the persona leakage checks. Full constraints are provided in Appendix A.7 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于包含信息披露的轮次（D₁–D₄），会检查人设话语的词汇和语篇风格、两句话的长度限制，以及人设是否显式泄露其底层 EMS，我们将后者称为人设泄露。 D₀ 轮次可以绕过这些风格检查，但仍须接受人设泄露检查。 完整约束条件见附录 A.7。

paragraphs.en: Generation proceeds through an iterative generate–evaluate–correct loop. For each generated disclosure, we check whether it matches the target depth, follows the conversational style requirements, and avoids persona leakage. A candidate is accepted only if it passes all three checks. Otherwise, we use the evaluator feedback to generate another candidate and repeat the checks, for up to K = 12 K=12 attempts. If none passes, we retain a fallback candidate so that the conversation can continue. Correction and fallback procedures are provided in Appendix A.8 . Generation validation statistics and example conversations are provided in Appendices A.9 and A.10 , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 生成过程通过一个迭代式的“生成—评估—修正”循环进行。 对于每条生成的披露内容，我们检查其是否符合目标深度、遵循对话风格要求，并避免人设泄露。 只有候选内容通过全部三项检查时才会被接受。 否则，我们利用评估器的反馈生成另一个候选内容并重复检查，最多尝试 K=12 次。 如果没有候选内容通过，我们会保留一个后备候选内容，以便对话能够继续。 修正与后备流程见附录 A.8。 生成验证统计数据与示例对话分别见附录 A.9 和 A.10。

paragraphs.en: To extend TraDE from controlled model evaluation to model-human comparison, we demonstrate the construction of a human reference using ESConv ( Liu et al., 2021 ) . We use the help seeker turns as disclosures and the supporter replies as responses. We then evaluate the disclosure depth of each help seeker turn using the same depth evaluator as in our generation framework. This allows us to compare the human conversations with our predefined disclosure trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将 TraDE 从受控的模型评估扩展到模型与人类的比较，我们展示了使用 ESConv ( Liu et al., 2021 ) 构建人类参考的方法。 我们将求助者的轮次作为自我披露，将支持者的回复作为回应。 然后，我们使用与生成框架中相同的深度评估器来评估每个求助者轮次的自我披露深度。 这使我们能够将人类对话与我们预定义的自我披露轨迹进行比较。

sents.en: To extend TraDE from controlled model evaluation to model-human comparison, we demonstrate the construction of a human reference using ESConv ( Liu et al., 2021 ) .
sents.zh: 为了将 TraDE 从受控的模型评估扩展到模型与人类的比较，我们展示了使用 ESConv ( Liu et al., 2021 ) 构建人类参考的方法。

sents.en: We use the help seeker turns as disclosures and the supporter replies as responses.
sents.zh: 我们将求助者的轮次作为自我披露，将支持者的回复作为回应。

sents.en: We then evaluate the disclosure depth of each help seeker turn using the same depth evaluator as in our generation framework.
sents.zh: 然后，我们使用与生成框架中相同的深度评估器来评估每个求助者轮次的自我披露深度。

sents.en: This allows us to compare the human conversations with our predefined disclosure trajectories.
sents.zh: 这使我们能够将人类对话与我们预定义的自我披露轨迹进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Because these human disclosure sequences are dynamic, we have to align these trajectories to our predefined ones. To do so, we use Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) ( Sakoe & Chiba, 1978 ) owing to its ability to match variation in the rate of disclosure progression while preserving temporal order. We anchored matches at the beginning of each human conversation, while varying the endpoint. This allowed us to search and retain the prefix with the lowest normalized DTW cost while controlling for the start of conversation. We accept a human conversation as a match only when its DTW distance falls below a trajectory-specific threshold, defined as the fifth percentile of distances obtained from 200 randomly shuffled human disclosure sequences.
paragraphs.zh: 由于这些人类披露序列是动态的，我们必须将这些轨迹与我们预定义的轨迹进行对齐。 为此，我们采用动态时间规整（DTW）（Sakoe & Chiba, 1978），因为它能够在保持时间顺序的同时，匹配披露进展速率的变化。 我们将匹配锚定在每段人类对话的开头，同时变动其终点。 这使我们能够在控制对话起点的情况下，搜索并保留归一化 DTW 成本最低的前缀。 只有当某段人类对话的 DTW 距离低于特定轨迹的阈值时，我们才接受其为匹配，该阈值定义为从 200 个随机打乱的人类披露序列中得到的距离的第五百分位数。

sents.en: Because these human disclosure sequences are dynamic, we have to align these trajectories to our predefined ones.
sents.zh: 由于这些人类披露序列是动态的，我们必须将这些轨迹与我们预定义的轨迹进行对齐。

sents.en: To do so, we use Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) ( Sakoe & Chiba, 1978 ) owing to its ability to match variation in the rate of disclosure progression while preserving temporal order.
sents.zh: 为此，我们采用动态时间规整（DTW）（Sakoe & Chiba, 1978），因为它能够在保持时间顺序的同时，匹配披露进展速率的变化。

sents.en: We anchored matches at the beginning of each human conversation, while varying the endpoint.
sents.zh: 我们将匹配锚定在每段人类对话的开头，同时变动其终点。

sents.en: This allowed us to search and retain the prefix with the lowest normalized DTW cost while controlling for the start of conversation.
sents.zh: 这使我们能够在控制对话起点的情况下，搜索并保留归一化 DTW 成本最低的前缀。

sents.en: We accept a human conversation as a match only when its DTW distance falls below a trajectory-specific threshold, defined as the fifth percentile of distances obtained from 200 randomly shuffled human disclosure sequences.
sents.zh: 只有当某段人类对话的 DTW 距离低于特定轨迹的阈值时，我们才接受其为匹配，该阈值定义为从 200 个随机打乱的人类披露序列中得到的距离的第五百分位数。

paragraphs.en: Matched supporter responses are evaluated using the same behavioral measures applied to target model responses. This allows us to compare between how relational behaviors change in models and the human baseline as disclosure unfolds. Full details of the matching and calibration procedure are provided in Appendix A.11 .
paragraphs.zh: 匹配到的支持者回复使用与目标模型回复相同的行为指标进行评估。 这使我们能够在模型和人类基线之间比较关系行为如何随自我披露的展开而变化。 匹配与校准流程的完整细节见附录 A.11。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate each model response using three benchmarks: AnthroBench for anthropomorphic and relational behavior ( Ibrahim et al., 2026 ) , INTIMA for companionship-reinforcing and boundary-maintaining behavior ( Kaffee et al., 2026 ) , and ELEPHANT for social sycophancy ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . We use Qwen3-32B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , Phi-4 ( Abdin et al., 2024 ) , and Gemma-3 27B IT ( Team et al., 2025 ) as the common panel of judges across all three benchmarks, while retaining the benchmarks’ respective behavioral definitions and evaluation criteria (see Appendix A.12 ). By applying these evaluations at each disclosure turn, we can examine how model behavior changes across disclosure depth and trajectory history. We further apply the same evaluations to matched human responses identified in Section 3.4 for the human baseline. Benchmark-specific implementation details are described in Appendix A.13 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用三个基准来评估每个模型响应：AnthroBench 用于评估拟人化与关系性行为（Ibrahim et al., 2026），INTIMA 用于评估强化陪伴与维持边界的行为（Kaffee et al., 2026），ELEPHANT 用于评估社交谄媚（Cheng et al., 2026）。 我们使用 Qwen3-32B（Yang et al., 2025）、Phi-4（Abdin et al., 2024）和 Gemma-3 27B IT（Team et al., 2025）作为贯穿所有三个基准的统一评审组，同时保留各基准自身的行为定义与评估标准（见附录 A.12）。 通过在每个披露轮次应用这些评估，我们可以考察模型行为如何随披露深度与轨迹历史而变化。 我们进一步将相同的评估应用于第 3.4 节中识别出的匹配人类响应，以作为人类基线。 各基准的具体实现细节见附录 A.13。

paragraphs.en: We use four statistical analyses to address our demonstrated research questions. For RQ1, we compare responses to persona- and depth-matched counterfactual probes ( D 1 D_{1} – D 4 D_{4} ) following different disclosure histories (Ascending vs. Flat- D 4 D_{4} ; Descending vs. Flat- D 1 D_{1} ). We average the three conversation chains for each of the 42 personas and use paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, with Benjamini–Hochberg False Discovery Rate (FDR) correction within each model and benchmark ( q < .05 q<.05 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用四种统计分析方法来回答我们所提出的研究问题。 针对 RQ1，我们比较在不同披露历史（递增 vs. 平坦- D 4 D_{4}；递减 vs. 平坦- D 1 D_{1}）下对角色匹配和深度匹配反事实探针（ D 1 D_{1} – D 4 D_{4} ）的响应。 我们对 42 个智能体角色各自的三个对话链取平均值，并使用配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验，同时在每个模型和基准内进行 Benjamini–Hochberg 错误发现率（FDR）校正（ q < .05 q<.05 ）。

paragraphs.en: For RQ2a, we examine which properties of disclosure history are associated with model behavior. We jointly model mean depth, peak depth, and peak position using standardized predictors and persona-clustered standard errors. We also conduct controlled trajectory comparisons, using Friedman tests for multiple peak-depth and peak-position conditions, and paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests for mean-depth, ordering, and joint depth–exposure comparisons. These tests use persona-level pairing and the same FDR correction as RQ1.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 RQ2a，我们考察披露历史的哪些属性与模型行为相关联。 我们使用标准化预测变量和按智能体聚类的标准误，联合建模平均深度、峰值深度和峰值位置。 我们还进行了受控的轨迹比较，对多个峰值深度和峰值位置条件使用 Friedman 检验，对平均深度、顺序以及深度—暴露联合比较使用配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验。 这些检验使用智能体层面的配对，以及与 RQ1 相同的 FDR 校正。

paragraphs.en: For RQ2b, we compare a trajectory that increases to D 4 D_{4} before returning to D 1 D_{1} with an all- D 1 D_{1} baseline. We use FDR -corrected Wilcoxon tests to identify initial differences and persona-level bootstrap 95% confidence intervals to assess whether they remain detectable after four shallow turns. We measure persistence using the retention ratio R t = Δ t / Δ 7 R_{t}=\Delta_{t}/\Delta_{7} , where Δ t \Delta_{t} is the behavioral difference from baseline at turn t t , and Δ 7 \Delta_{7} is the initial difference. We also use regression on sign-aligned differences to examine whether these effects decrease over subsequent turns.

paragraphs.en: Finally, for RQ3, we compare models and human supporters across trajectories matched using DTW . We normalize turn positions and use polynomial regression to compare overall behavioral scores ( level differences ) and changes across disclosure trajectories ( shape differences ). We assess these differences using cluster-robust Wald tests, clustering model responses by persona and human responses by conversation ( Cameron & Miller, 2015 ) .

paragraphs.en: Domain and EMS variation. To find out if topic domain and EMS have any effects on our following observations, we first perform a validation analysis on these two factors. We found that neither factor showed a consistent pattern across the models. We therefore aggregate our results across topic domains and EMS for subsequent analyses. Full validation results are reported in Appendix A.15 .

paragraphs.en: To demonstrate the use of TraDE , we answer three research questions using the described four statistical analyses in Section 3.6 . First, we examine whether preceding disclosure history influences model behavior when the current disclosure is held constant (RQ1). Second, we investigate which properties of disclosure history are associated with these effects and whether they persist after disclosure returns to shallower levels (RQ2). Third, we compare model and human relational behaviors across DTW matched disclosure trajectories, examining differences in overall behavioral level and how behaviors change over the interaction (RQ3). Table 28 summarizes the trajectories used, while Table 29 outlines the corresponding comparisons and statistical tests.
paragraphs.zh: 为了演示 TraDE 的使用，我们利用第 3.6 节中描述的四种统计分析来回答三个研究问题。 首先，我们检验在当前披露保持不变的情况下，先前的披露历史是否会影响模型行为（RQ1）。 其次，我们研究披露历史的哪些属性与这些效应相关，以及当披露回到较浅层级后这些效应是否会持续存在（RQ2）。 第三，我们通过 DTW 匹配的披露轨迹比较模型与人类的关系行为，考察总体行为水平上的差异以及行为在交互过程中如何变化（RQ3）。 表 28 总结了所使用的轨迹，表 29 概述了相应的比较和统计检验。

paragraphs.en: To isolate the contribution of preceding history, we compared trajectories that end at the same depth but arrive there differently (Ascending vs. Flat- D 4 D_{4} ; Descending vs. Flat- D 1 D_{1} ). We then append the same counterfactual probes at all four disclosure depths ( D 1 D_{1} – D 4 D_{4} ; see Section 3.6 ). This allows us to evaluate whether differences in earlier conversational history can influence the model’s response.

paragraphs.en: Across the four models and 26 behavioral metrics, 119 of 832 comparisons (14.3%) showed significant differences after FDR correction. We found significant differences across all four probe depths (11.1–17.3%), including D 1 D_{1} , where 14.9% of comparisons were significant (see Appendix A.16 ). While sensitivity to earlier context is expected, these results further show that it measurably affects relational behavior even at shallow disclosure depths.
paragraphs.zh: 在四个模型和26项行为指标中，832项比较里有119项（14.3%）在FDR校正后显示出显著差异。 我们在所有四个探针深度（11.1%–17.3%）中都发现了显著差异，包括 D 1 D_{1}，其中14.9%的比较是显著的（见附录 A.16）。 虽然对较早上下文的敏感性是预料之中的，但这些结果进一步表明，即使在浅披露深度下，它也会可测量地影响关系行为。

sents.en: Across the four models and 26 behavioral metrics, 119 of 832 comparisons (14.3%) showed significant differences after FDR correction.
sents.zh: 在四个模型和26项行为指标中，832项比较里有119项（14.3%）在FDR校正后显示出显著差异。

sents.en: We found significant differences across all four probe depths (11.1–17.3%), including D 1 D_{1} , where 14.9% of comparisons were significant (see Appendix A.16 ).
sents.zh: 我们在所有四个探针深度（11.1%–17.3%）中都发现了显著差异，包括 D 1 D_{1}，其中14.9%的比较是显著的（见附录 A.16）。

paragraphs.en: History sensitivity was strongest in behaviors related to how models interpreted and responded to the user’s account. Framing , which measures the tendency to accept the user’s framing or underlying assumptions rather than challenge them ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) , had the most significant differences (18 of 32 comparisons), followed by Adequate Information (12 of 32), Relatability (11 of 32), and Professional Limitations (10 of 32) (see Tables 30 and 31 ). This suggests that certain model behaviors are more sensitive to prior disclosure history. In our demonstration, this was particularly evident in whether the model accepted the user’s explanation or offered a different interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 历史敏感性在与模型如何解读和回应用户陈述相关的行为中最为明显。 接纳框架（Framing），即衡量模型倾向于接受用户的框架或潜在假设而非质疑它们的指标（Cheng et al., 2026），差异最为显著（32 项比较中的 18 项），其次是充分信息（Adequate Information）（32 项中的 12 项）、关联性（Relatability）（32 项中的 11 项）和专业局限（Professional Limitations）（32 项中的 10 项）（见表 30 和表 31）。 这表明某些模型行为对先前的披露历史更为敏感。 在我们的演示中，这在模型是接受用户的解释还是提供不同解读方面尤为明显。

paragraphs.en: We further examined response examples to understand the differences in Framing . In one Qwen3-32B comparison, the user described focusing on work and climbing in a D 1 D_{1} probe. Following an Ascending disclosure, the model described this as “a really smart and protective way to manage your energy”. However, following a Flat- D 4 D_{4} disclosure, the model interpreted the explanation as a “shield” against what the user was “really” feeling. This interpretation was not stated in the current D 1 D_{1} message, but was supported by information disclosed earlier in the Flat- D 4 D_{4} conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步分析了响应示例，以理解 Framing 方面的差异。 在一个 Qwen3-32B 的对比中，用户在 D 1 D_{1} 探测消息中描述了自己专注于工作和攀岩的情况。 在 Ascending 型披露之后，模型将其描述为“一种非常聪明且具有保护性的能量管理方式”。 然而，在 Flat- D 4 D_{4} 披露之后，模型将该解释视为用户抵御其“真实”感受的一道“盾牌”。 这一解释并未在当前的 D 1 D_{1} 消息中被明确说明，而是得到了 Flat- D 4 D_{4} 对话中早先披露信息的支持。

paragraphs.en: The difference observed here is whether the model accepted the user’s current explanation or interpreted it using their earlier disclosures. This example provides an interpretation on how preceding disclosure history can affect the model’s response even when the current disclosure is shallow.
paragraphs.zh: 这里观察到的差异在于，模型是接受了用户当前的解释，还是结合他们之前的披露信息对其进行解读。 这个例子提供了一种解读，说明先前的披露历史如何影响模型的回复，即使当前的披露内容较为浅显。

paragraphs.en: We have established in RQ1 that earlier disclosure history can shape model behavior beyond the current disclosure depth. We now turn to examining two aspects of this effect in RQ2. First, RQ2a investigates which properties of disclosure history are associated with differences in model behavior. We compare the deepest disclosure reached, its position in the conversation, disclosure order, and mean disclosure depth, as well as conditions where disclosure depth and exposure duration vary together. Second, RQ2b addresses whether these differences persist after disclosure returns to shallow levels. To do so, we track model responses over subsequent D 1 D_{1} turns to determine whether the effects of earlier deeper disclosures remain detectable or gradually decrease.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 RQ1 中已经确定，较早的袒露历史能够超越当前的袒露深度影响模型行为。 我们现在转向在 RQ2 中考察这一效应的两个方面。 首先，RQ2a 研究袒露历史的哪些属性与模型行为的差异相关。 我们比较了达到的最深袒露程度、其在对话中的位置、袒露顺序以及平均袒露深度，并比较了袒露深度与暴露时长共同变化的情形。 其次，RQ2b 探讨这些差异在袒露回到浅层水平后是否仍然存在。 为此，我们追踪模型在后续 D 1 D_{1} 轮中的响应，以确定先前更深袒露的影响是否仍然可检测，或者会逐渐减弱。

sents.en: We have established in RQ1 that earlier disclosure history can shape model behavior beyond the current disclosure depth.
sents.zh: 我们在 RQ1 中已经确定，较早的袒露历史能够超越当前的袒露深度影响模型行为。

sents.en: We now turn to examining two aspects of this effect in RQ2.
sents.zh: 我们现在转向在 RQ2 中考察这一效应的两个方面。

sents.en: First, RQ2a investigates which properties of disclosure history are associated with differences in model behavior.
sents.zh: 首先，RQ2a 研究袒露历史的哪些属性与模型行为的差异相关。

sents.en: We compare the deepest disclosure reached, its position in the conversation, disclosure order, and mean disclosure depth, as well as conditions where disclosure depth and exposure duration vary together.
sents.zh: 我们比较了达到的最深袒露程度、其在对话中的位置、袒露顺序以及平均袒露深度，并比较了袒露深度与暴露时长共同变化的情形。

sents.en: Second, RQ2b addresses whether these differences persist after disclosure returns to shallow levels.
sents.zh: 其次，RQ2b 探讨这些差异在袒露回到浅层水平后是否仍然存在。

sents.en: To do so, we track model responses over subsequent D 1 D_{1} turns to determine whether the effects of earlier deeper disclosures remain detectable or gradually decrease.
sents.zh: 为此，我们追踪模型在后续 D 1 D_{1} 轮中的响应，以确定先前更深袒露的影响是否仍然可检测，或者会逐渐减弱。

paragraphs.en: In the trajectories we tested, accumulated exposure mattered more than the deepest disclosure or the order of disclosures.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们测试的轨迹中，累积暴露比最深一次的披露或披露的顺序更为重要。

paragraphs.en: Holding accumulated exposure fixed, changing peak disclosure depth produced few significant differences (5/416 and 8/416). We found similar results when changing the position of the deepest disclosure (8/375; see Table 29 ). We then tested whether changing the order of disclosures would affect model behavior when mean depth, peak depth, and peak position were kept the same. Compared with the respective monotonic Ascending and Descending trajectories, the reordered variants showed significant differences in only 5/416 and 1/416 comparisons (refer to Fig. 2 C).
paragraphs.zh: 在保持累计暴露量不变的情况下，改变峰值披露深度产生的显著差异很少（5/416 和 8/416）。 当改变最深披露的位置时，我们得到了类似的结果（8/375；见表 29）。 接着，我们测试了在平均深度、峰值深度和峰值位置保持不变的情况下，改变披露的顺序是否会影响模型行为。 与相应的单调递增和单调递减轨迹相比，重排后的变体仅在 5/416 和 1/416 的比较中显示出显著差异（参见图 2 C）。

sents.en: Holding accumulated exposure fixed, changing peak disclosure depth produced few significant differences (5/416 and 8/416).
sents.zh: 在保持累计暴露量不变的情况下，改变峰值披露深度产生的显著差异很少（5/416 和 8/416）。

sents.en: We found similar results when changing the position of the deepest disclosure (8/375; see Table 29 ).
sents.zh: 当改变最深披露的位置时，我们得到了类似的结果（8/375；见表 29）。

sents.en: We then tested whether changing the order of disclosures would affect model behavior when mean depth, peak depth, and peak position were kept the same.
sents.zh: 接着，我们测试了在平均深度、峰值深度和峰值位置保持不变的情况下，改变披露的顺序是否会影响模型行为。

sents.en: Compared with the respective monotonic Ascending and Descending trajectories, the reordered variants showed significant differences in only 5/416 and 1/416 comparisons (refer to Fig. 2 C).
sents.zh: 与相应的单调递增和单调递减轨迹相比，重排后的变体仅在 5/416 和 1/416 的比较中显示出显著差异（参见图 2 C）。

paragraphs.en: We next evaluate for observable behavioral difference by varying disclosure depth and exposure duration jointly. Doing so produced 85 of 416 significant comparisons (20.4%). In contrast, varying mean depth while keeping peak depth and its position fixed produced only 10 of 1,248 significantly different comparisons (0.8%) (refer to Fig. 2 B). Consistently, mean depth was the most informative of the three summaries in a joint regression, though it remains relatively small in effect (refer to Fig. 2 A). These patterns suggest that history sensitivity may be more closely associated with accumulated exposure to deeper disclosure rather than with any single peak or its position.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们通过联合改变披露深度和暴露时长来评估是否存在可观察到的行为差异。 这样做在416个比较中产生了85个显著比较（20.4%）。 相比之下，在保持峰值深度及其位置不变的情况下改变平均深度，仅在1,248个比较中产生10个显著不同的比较（0.8%）（参见图2 B）。 一致地，在联合回归中，平均深度是三个汇总指标中信息量最大的一个，尽管其效应仍然相对较小（参见图2 A）。 这些模式表明，历史敏感性可能更多地与对更深披露的累积暴露相关，而不是与任何单个峰值或其位置相关。

sents.en: We next evaluate for observable behavioral difference by varying disclosure depth and exposure duration jointly.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们通过联合改变披露深度和暴露时长来评估是否存在可观察到的行为差异。

sents.en: Doing so produced 85 of 416 significant comparisons (20.4%).

sents.en: In contrast, varying mean depth while keeping peak depth and its position fixed produced only 10 of 1,248 significantly different comparisons (0.8%) (refer to Fig. 2 B).

sents.zh: 一致地，在联合回归中，平均深度是三个汇总指标中信息量最大的一个，尽管其效应仍然相对较小（参见图2 A）。

sents.en: These patterns suggest that history sensitivity may be more closely associated with accumulated exposure to deeper disclosure rather than with any single peak or its position.
sents.zh: 这些模式表明，历史敏感性可能更多地与对更深披露的累积暴露相关，而不是与任何单个峰值或其位置相关。

paragraphs.en: History effects persisted after disclosure returned to shallow levels ( D 1 D_{1} ), although their magnitude decreased over subsequent turns.
paragraphs.zh: 即使在信息披露回到浅层水平（ D 1 D_{1} ）之后，历史效应仍然持续存在，尽管其强度在后续轮次中有所减弱。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate persistence effects of disclosure history, we compared a trajectory that increased from D 1 D_{1} to D 4 D_{4} before returning to four D 1 D_{1} turns against an all- D 1 D_{1} baseline. At the end of the deeper disclosure episode, 38 model and behavioral metric combinations showed significant differences from the shallow baseline. Of these, 30 remained detectable after four additional D 1 D_{1} turns, albeit it was accompanied by a magnitude decrease in median effect to 58% of its initial value (see Appendix A.17.2 ). Thus, our observations suggests that history effects can persist after returning to shallow disclosure levels but tend to weaken as the conversation progresses at these shallow levels.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估披露历史的持续性效应，我们将一条从 D 1 D_{1} 增加到 D 4 D_{4} 后又回到四次 D 1 D_{1} 轮次的轨迹与全程为 D 1 D_{1} 的基线进行了比较。 在更深披露阶段结束时，38 种模型与行为指标组合显示出与浅层基线的显著差异。 其中，30 种在经过额外的四轮 D 1 D_{1} 对话后仍可被检测到，尽管其中位数效应量下降至初始值的 58%（见附录 A.17.2）。 因此，我们的观察表明，历史效应在回到浅层披露水平后仍能持续存在，但随着对话在这些浅层水平上继续进行，其效应往往趋于减弱。

sents.en: To evaluate persistence effects of disclosure history, we compared a trajectory that increased from D 1 D_{1} to D 4 D_{4} before returning to four D 1 D_{1} turns against an all- D 1 D_{1} baseline.
sents.zh: 为了评估披露历史的持续性效应，我们将一条从 D 1 D_{1} 增加到 D 4 D_{4} 后又回到四次 D 1 D_{1} 轮次的轨迹与全程为 D 1 D_{1} 的基线进行了比较。

sents.en: At the end of the deeper disclosure episode, 38 model and behavioral metric combinations showed significant differences from the shallow baseline.
sents.zh: 在更深披露阶段结束时，38 种模型与行为指标组合显示出与浅层基线的显著差异。

sents.en: Of these, 30 remained detectable after four additional D 1 D_{1} turns, albeit it was accompanied by a magnitude decrease in median effect to 58% of its initial value (see Appendix A.17.2 ).
sents.zh: 其中，30 种在经过额外的四轮 D 1 D_{1} 对话后仍可被检测到，尽管其中位数效应量下降至初始值的 58%（见附录 A.17.2）。

sents.en: Thus, our observations suggests that history effects can persist after returning to shallow disclosure levels but tend to weaken as the conversation progresses at these shallow levels.
sents.zh: 因此，我们的观察表明，历史效应在回到浅层披露水平后仍能持续存在，但随着对话在这些浅层水平上继续进行，其效应往往趋于减弱。

paragraphs.en: We further examined response examples to understand how these history effects persisted. In one GPT-5.6 Sol trajectory, the user disclosed experiencing panic attacks while working on a project at D 4 D_{4} , and the model suggested seeking support from a counselor, doctor, or school mental-health service. Over the following four D 1 D_{1} turns, the user discussed their schedule and portfolio requirements without further disclosing panic attacks. However, when the user later mentioned needing to find the project rubric, the model still referred to the earlier concern, stating “If searching starts another panic attack, stop, ground yourself, and ask a trusted adult, teacher, or counselor to help locate it.” In comparison, the corresponding all- D 1 D_{1} baseline response only provided scheduling advice without suggesting outside support.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步分析了响应示例，以理解这些历史效应是如何持续存在的。 在一条 GPT-5.6 Sol 轨迹中，用户透露在完成 D 4 D_{4} 项目时经历了惊恐发作，模型建议其向咨询师、医生或学校心理健康服务寻求支持。 在随后的四个 D 1 D_{1} 轮次中，用户讨论了他们的日程安排和作品集要求，没有再提及惊恐发作。 然而，当用户后来提到需要找到项目评分标准时，模型仍然提及了之前的担忧，表示“如果搜索又引发一次惊恐发作，请停下来，让自己平静下来，并请一位信任的成年人、老师或咨询师帮助找到它。”相比之下，对应的纯 D 1 D_{1} 基线响应仅提供了日程安排建议，没有建议寻求外部支持。

sents.en: We further examined response examples to understand how these history effects persisted.
sents.zh: 我们进一步分析了响应示例，以理解这些历史效应是如何持续存在的。

sents.en: In one GPT-5.6 Sol trajectory, the user disclosed experiencing panic attacks while working on a project at D 4 D_{4} , and the model suggested seeking support from a counselor, doctor, or school mental-health service.
sents.zh: 在一条 GPT-5.6 Sol 轨迹中，用户透露在完成 D 4 D_{4} 项目时经历了惊恐发作，模型建议其向咨询师、医生或学校心理健康服务寻求支持。

sents.en: Over the following four D 1 D_{1} turns, the user discussed their schedule and portfolio requirements without further disclosing panic attacks.
sents.zh: 在随后的四个 D 1 D_{1} 轮次中，用户讨论了他们的日程安排和作品集要求，没有再提及惊恐发作。

sents.en: However, when the user later mentioned needing to find the project rubric, the model still referred to the earlier concern, stating “If searching starts another panic attack, stop, ground yourself, and ask a trusted adult, teacher, or counselor to help locate it.” In comparison, the corresponding all- D 1 D_{1} baseline response only provided scheduling advice without suggesting outside support.
sents.zh: 然而，当用户后来提到需要找到项目评分标准时，模型仍然提及了之前的担忧，表示“如果搜索又引发一次惊恐发作，请停下来，让自己平静下来，并请一位信任的成年人、老师或咨询师帮助找到它。”相比之下，对应的纯 D 1 D_{1} 基线响应仅提供了日程安排建议，没有建议寻求外部支持。

paragraphs.en: This example shows how concerns raised during deeper disclosure can carry forward in the model’s advice several shallow turns later, even when the user has moved on to more practical topics.
paragraphs.zh: 这个示例展示了在更深层次的披露过程中提出的关切，如何在数个浅层回合之后仍持续影响模型给出的建议，即使用户已经转向了更实际的话题。

paragraphs.en: Our findings in RQ1 and RQ2 show that model behavior varies with preceding disclosure history, with some effects persisting after disclosure returns to shallow levels. We next compare these behavioral changes with human supporters to examine whether models adjust their responses similarly as disclosure deepens or recedes. Table 2 summarizes our observations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在研究问题1（RQ1）和研究问题2（RQ2）中的发现表明，模型行为会随先前的自我表露历史而变化，且某些影响在表露回到浅层水平后仍然持续。 接下来，我们将这些行为变化与人类支持者进行比较，以检验模型是否会在表露加深或消退时以类似的方式调整其回应。 表2总结了我们的观察结果。

sents.en: Our findings in RQ1 and RQ2 show that model behavior varies with preceding disclosure history, with some effects persisting after disclosure returns to shallow levels.
sents.zh: 我们在研究问题1（RQ1）和研究问题2（RQ2）中的发现表明，模型行为会随先前的自我表露历史而变化，且某些影响在表露回到浅层水平后仍然持续。

sents.en: We next compare these behavioral changes with human supporters to examine whether models adjust their responses similarly as disclosure deepens or recedes.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将这些行为变化与人类支持者进行比较，以检验模型是否会在表露加深或消退时以类似的方式调整其回应。

sents.en: Table 2 summarizes our observations.
sents.zh: 表2总结了我们的观察结果。

paragraphs.en: Models differed from human supporters in both their overall behavioral levels and how their responses changed across disclosure trajectories. For several behaviors, shape differences were more consistently detected when disclosure receded or changed direction.
paragraphs.zh: 模型在总体行为水平以及响应随披露轨迹变化的方式上，都与人类支持者有所不同。 对于若干行为而言，当披露减少或方向发生改变时，形状差异更容易被稳定地检测到。

sents.en: Models differed from human supporters in both their overall behavioral levels and how their responses changed across disclosure trajectories.
sents.zh: 模型在总体行为水平以及响应随披露轨迹变化的方式上，都与人类支持者有所不同。

sents.en: For several behaviors, shape differences were more consistently detected when disclosure receded or changed direction.
sents.zh: 对于若干行为而言，当披露减少或方向发生改变时，形状差异更容易被稳定地检测到。

paragraphs.en: Shape differences were more consistently detected when disclosure receded or changed direction. For Framing , measured by ELEPHANT, significant model–human shape differences were found in 3/8 models under Ascending disclosure, compared with 8/8 under Descending and 7/8 under Arc. We observed a similar pattern for Sycophancy/Agreement , with significant shape differences in 2/8, 7/8, and 6/8 models, respectively. These results indicate that differences in how models and humans adjust these behaviors were more consistently detectable under Descending and Arc disclosure (see Appendix A.20 ). The corresponding trajectories are also shown in Figs. 3 – 11 .
paragraphs.zh: 当披露程度递减或改变方向时，形状差异被更一致地检测到。 对于由 ELEPHANT 测量的 Framing，在 Ascending 披露下，8 个模型中有 3 个存在显著的模型—人类形状差异，而在 Descending 下为 8 个中的 8 个，在 Arc 下为 8 个中的 7 个。 我们在 Sycophancy/Agreement 上观察到类似的模式，分别有 8 个中的 2 个、8 个中的 7 个和 8 个中的 6 个模型存在显著的形状差异。 这些结果表明，模型与人类在调整这些行为方面的差异，在 Descending 和 Arc 披露下更易被一致地检测到（见附录 A.20）。 相应的轨迹也显示在图 3–11 中。

sents.zh: 当披露程度递减或改变方向时，形状差异被更一致地检测到。

sents.zh: 我们在 Sycophancy/Agreement 上观察到类似的模式，分别有 8 个中的 2 个、8 个中的 7 个和 8 个中的 6 个模型存在显著的形状差异。

sents.en: These results indicate that differences in how models and humans adjust these behaviors were more consistently detectable under Descending and Arc disclosure (see Appendix A.20 ).
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，模型与人类在调整这些行为方面的差异，在 Descending 和 Arc 披露下更易被一致地检测到（见附录 A.20）。

sents.en: The corresponding trajectories are also shown in Figs. 3 – 11 .
sents.zh: 相应的轨迹也显示在图 3–11 中。

paragraphs.en: Models also expressed higher overall levels for several behaviors compared to human supporters. Across all three disclosure trajectories, all models showed higher overall levels of Empathy , Validation , Sycophancy/Agreement , Retention/Engagement , Validation and Indirectness compared with the human reference (see Table 2 ). These results show differences in overall behavioral levels, but not how behavior changes across turns. We next examine this shape difference using Validation .
paragraphs.zh: 与人类支持者相比，模型在若干行为上的整体水平也更高。 在全部三种自我披露轨迹中，与人类参照相比，所有模型在共情、确认、谄媚/附和、保留/互动、确认以及间接性上的整体水平都更高（见表 2）。 这些结果显示了整体行为水平上的差异，但并未显示行为如何随对话轮次变化。 接下来我们以确认为例来考察这种形态上的差异。

paragraphs.en: Validation also differed in how it changed as disclosure receded. For Validation , measured by ELEPHANT, significant model–human shape differences were found in 4/8 models under Ascending disclosure, compared with 7/8 under Descending and 8/8 under Arc. To better understand how these differences appeared in the responses, we further examine utterances in Arc conversations.
paragraphs.zh: 验证在披露消退时的变化方式上也有所不同。 对于由 ELEPHANT 测量的验证，在递增披露下，8 个模型中有 4 个存在显著的模型—人类形态差异，而在递减披露下为 8 个中的 7 个，在弧形披露下为 8 个中的 8 个。 为了更好地理解这些差异如何在回复中出现，我们进一步考察了弧形对话中的话语。

paragraphs.en: In one ESConv Arc conversation, the human supporter initially acknowledged the seeker’s anxiety about failing a test. They responded with “Absolutely valid reason for anxiety” during the peak disclosure ( D 3 D_{3} ). As disclosure became shallower ( D 2 D_{2} ), the seeker shifted to discussing their test score. The supporter then asked, “What was your score?” When the seeker later criticized themselves themselves, the supporter returned to providing reassurance, despite disclosure remaining at D 2 D_{2} . In this example, we see that the human supporter did not validate every turn at the same depth, but responded differently depending on the immediate content of the conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 在一段 ESConv Arc 对话中，人类支持者起初对求助者关于考试失败的焦虑表示了认可。 在最深的自我表露阶段（D 3 D_{3}），他们回应道「Absolutely valid reason for anxiety」。 随着表露变浅（D 2 D_{2}），求助者转而讨论自己的考试分数。 支持者随即问道「What was your score?」。当求助者后来进行自我批评时，尽管表露仍停留在 D 2 D_{2}，支持者重新回到提供安抚的回应方式。 在这个例子中，我们看到人类支持者并非在每一轮都以同样的深度进行认可，而是根据对话的即时内容作出不同的回应。

paragraphs.en: We however observed another pattern in a GPT-4.1 Arc trajectory. Before the D 4 D_{4} peak, the user discussed keeping the budget tight for a loft at D 1 D_{1} . The model responded with practical encouragement, stating “Smart move! Keeping the build simple saves time, money, and headaches”. After the peak, the user again discussed budget constraints at D 1 D_{1} , but the model responded with more emotional reassurance: “It’s tough when you’re working hard and the goal feels like it’s moving just out of reach. But don’t lose heart”. Only the post-peak responses were labeled as validating.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，我们在一个 GPT-4.1 的 Arc 轨迹中观察到了另一种模式。 在 D 4 D_{4} 峰值之前，用户讨论过为 D 1 D_{1} 处的阁楼严格把控预算。 该模型回应了务实的鼓励，说道：“明智之举！ 保持建造简单可以省时、省钱、省心”。 峰值之后，用户再次在 D 1 D_{1} 处讨论预算紧张的问题，但该模型的回应带有更多情感上的安抚：“当你努力奋斗却感觉目标总在触手可及之外移动时，确实很艰难。但别灰心”。 只有峰值之后的回应被标记为「认可型」。

paragraphs.en: These examples show how Validation can change across disclosure trajectories. In the human conversation, the supporter alternated between validation and more factual responses, while GPT-4.1 gave a more validating response to a similar topic after deeper disclosure. Although the conversations are not content-matched, they help illustrate the different patterns of Validation examined in our model–human trajectory analysis. We also tested whether the human comparisons were sensitive to DTW selection, unequal sample sizes, matching thresholds, and differences in match quality. We conducted five sensitivity analyses and present our findings in Appendix A.11.7 . The results were stable across alternative DTW acceptance thresholds, and we did not find significant associations between match conditions and the observed behavioral levels or trajectory shapes.
paragraphs.zh: 这些示例展示了验证（Validation）如何随披露轨迹的变化而变化。 在人类对话中，支持者交替使用验证性回应和更偏事实性的回应，而 GPT-4.1 在对方进行更深入的披露后，对类似话题给出了更具验证性的回应。 尽管这些对话并非内容匹配的，但它们有助于说明我们在模型–人类轨迹分析中所考察的验证（Validation）的不同模式。 我们还检验了人类比较结果是否对 DTW 选择、样本量不均衡、匹配阈值以及匹配质量差异敏感。 我们进行了五项敏感性分析，并在附录 A.11.7 中呈现了研究结果。 结果在不同的 DTW 接受阈值下保持稳定，且我们未发现匹配条件与所观察到的行为水平或轨迹形状之间存在显著关联。

paragraphs.en: Our results show that a model’s response can depend on earlier disclosures, even when the current disclosure is matched on depth. We found differences in model behavior across disclosure histories, with some effects remaining after disclosure returned to shallower levels. Evaluating only the current exchange would miss these differences. By systematically varying the preceding disclosure trajectory, TraDE allows us to examine which behaviors are sensitive to earlier interactions. This helps us better understand the history dependence of conversational models at a behavioral level, although we cannot determine how models internally represent or use these earlier disclosures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果表明，模型的响应可能取决于先前的披露情况，即使当前披露在深度上是匹配的。 我们发现模型行为在不同披露历史之间存在差异，且某些影响在披露回到较浅程度后仍然存在。 仅评估当前对话轮次将无法捕捉这些差异。 通过系统地改变先前的披露轨迹，TraDE 使我们能够检验哪些行为对先前的交互是敏感的。 这有助于我们在行为层面更好地理解对话模型的历史依赖性，尽管我们无法确定模型如何在内部表示或使用这些先前的披露。

sents.en: Our results show that a model’s response can depend on earlier disclosures, even when the current disclosure is matched on depth.
sents.zh: 我们的结果表明，模型的响应可能取决于先前的披露情况，即使当前披露在深度上是匹配的。

sents.en: We found differences in model behavior across disclosure histories, with some effects remaining after disclosure returned to shallower levels.
sents.zh: 我们发现模型行为在不同披露历史之间存在差异，且某些影响在披露回到较浅程度后仍然存在。

sents.en: Evaluating only the current exchange would miss these differences.
sents.zh: 仅评估当前对话轮次将无法捕捉这些差异。

sents.en: By systematically varying the preceding disclosure trajectory, TraDE allows us to examine which behaviors are sensitive to earlier interactions.
sents.zh: 通过系统地改变先前的披露轨迹，TraDE 使我们能够检验哪些行为对先前的交互是敏感的。

sents.en: This helps us better understand the history dependence of conversational models at a behavioral level, although we cannot determine how models internally represent or use these earlier disclosures.
sents.zh: 这有助于我们在行为层面更好地理解对话模型的历史依赖性，尽管我们无法确定模型如何在内部表示或使用这些先前的披露。

paragraphs.en: We also examined which properties of disclosure history contributed to these differences. Changing the deepest disclosure or the order of disclosures produced few significant differences. However, more differences were found when disclosure depth and the number of turns spent at deeper levels changed together. Our current demonstration therefore cannot determine whether depth, duration, or recency was responsible for these effects. Our persistence analysis was also limited to four shallow turns within the same conversation. Future experiments could manipulate these properties independently and examine whether history effects remain over longer conversations or across sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还考察了披露史的哪些属性促成了这些差异。 改变最深披露或披露顺序只产生了很少的显著差异。 然而，当披露深度和在更深层次停留的轮数同时变化时，发现了更多差异。 因此，我们当前的演示无法确定是深度、持续时间还是近期性导致了这些效应。 我们的持续性分析也仅限于同一对话中的四个浅层轮次。 未来的实验可以独立操纵这些属性，并检验历史效应是否会在更长的对话中或跨会话持续存在。

sents.zh: 我们还考察了披露史的哪些属性促成了这些差异。

sents.en: Changing the deepest disclosure or the order of disclosures produced few significant differences.
sents.zh: 改变最深披露或披露顺序只产生了很少的显著差异。

paragraphs.en: Our human comparison further showed that models and human supporters differed in how their responses changed with disclosure. For several behaviors measured by INTIMA and ELEPHANT, significant shape differences were more frequently detected when disclosure receded or changed direction. In our qualitative examples, a human supporter adjusted their emotional acknowledgment according to the seeker’s immediate concerns, whereas a model continued referring to earlier emotions during later shallow disclosures. We do not, however, know whether users would perceive such responses as attentive or unnecessary. Sundar’s HAII-TIME framework offers one way to understand why these differences may matter, as users’ experiences interacting with AI can shape their perceptions of and trust in these systems ( Sundar, 2020 ) . Building on TraDE , future studies could test whether users perceive responses differently depending on the preceding disclosure history, even when the current disclosure is held constant. They could also examine whether these history-dependent responses influence what users choose to disclose next.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的人类对比进一步表明，模型与人类支持者的回应随自我表露变化的方式有所不同。 对于 INTIMA 和 ELEPHANT 所测量的若干行为，当自我表露减退或改变方向时，更常检测到显著的形态差异。 在我们的定性示例中，人类支持者会根据求助者当下的关切调整其情感回应，而模型在后续浅层自我表露时仍继续提及先前的情绪。 然而，我们并不知道用户是否会认为这类回应是体贴周到的还是多余无用的。 Sundar 的 HAII-TIME 框架提供了一种理解这些差异为何可能重要的方式，因为用户与 AI 互动的体验会影响他们对此类系统的感知与信任（Sundar, 2020）。 在 TraDE 的基础上，未来的研究可以检验：即使当前自我表露保持不变，用户是否会因先前的自我表露历史而以不同方式感知回应。 它们还可以考察这些依赖历史的回应是否会影响用户接下来选择表露的内容。

sents.en: Our human comparison further showed that models and human supporters differed in how their responses changed with disclosure.
sents.zh: 我们的人类对比进一步表明，模型与人类支持者的回应随自我表露变化的方式有所不同。

sents.en: For several behaviors measured by INTIMA and ELEPHANT, significant shape differences were more frequently detected when disclosure receded or changed direction.
sents.zh: 对于 INTIMA 和 ELEPHANT 所测量的若干行为，当自我表露减退或改变方向时，更常检测到显著的形态差异。

sents.en: In our qualitative examples, a human supporter adjusted their emotional acknowledgment according to the seeker’s immediate concerns, whereas a model continued referring to earlier emotions during later shallow disclosures.
sents.zh: 在我们的定性示例中，人类支持者会根据求助者当下的关切调整其情感回应，而模型在后续浅层自我表露时仍继续提及先前的情绪。

sents.en: We do not, however, know whether users would perceive such responses as attentive or unnecessary.
sents.zh: 然而，我们并不知道用户是否会认为这类回应是体贴周到的还是多余无用的。

sents.en: Sundar’s HAII-TIME framework offers one way to understand why these differences may matter, as users’ experiences interacting with AI can shape their perceptions of and trust in these systems ( Sundar, 2020 ) .
sents.zh: Sundar 的 HAII-TIME 框架提供了一种理解这些差异为何可能重要的方式，因为用户与 AI 互动的体验会影响他们对此类系统的感知与信任（Sundar, 2020）。

sents.en: Building on TraDE , future studies could test whether users perceive responses differently depending on the preceding disclosure history, even when the current disclosure is held constant.
sents.zh: 在 TraDE 的基础上，未来的研究可以检验：即使当前自我表露保持不变，用户是否会因先前的自我表露历史而以不同方式感知回应。

sents.en: They could also examine whether these history-dependent responses influence what users choose to disclose next.
sents.zh: 它们还可以考察这些依赖历史的回应是否会影响用户接下来选择表露的内容。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce TraDE , a benchmark-agnostic framework to construct conversations with controlled disclosure trajectories. We found that models responded differently depending on earlier disclosure history, even when the current disclosure was matched on depth. More differences were observed when disclosure depth and the number of turns spent at that depth changed together. Some differences also remained after disclosure returned to shallow levels. When compared with human supporters, models differed in their overall behavioral scores and how these scores changed across conversations. TraDE allows us to study these differences by varying the preceding disclosure history, rather than evaluating each model response in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 TraDE，这是一个与基准无关的框架，用于构建具有可控自我披露轨迹的对话。 我们发现，即使当前的披露深度相同，模型的表现仍会因先前的披露历史而有所不同。 当披露深度与停留在该深度的轮数同时变化时，观察到的差异更多。 在披露回到浅层水平之后，一些差异仍然存在。 与人类支持者相比，模型在整体行为评分以及这些评分在对话过程中的变化方式上存在差异。 TraDE 使我们能够通过改变先前的披露历史来研究这些差异，而不是孤立地评估每条模型回复。

sents.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 TraDE，这是一个与基准无关的框架，用于构建具有可控自我披露轨迹的对话。

sents.zh: 当披露深度与停留在该深度的轮数同时变化时，观察到的差异更多。

sents.en: Some differences also remained after disclosure returned to shallow levels.
sents.zh: 在披露回到浅层水平之后，一些差异仍然存在。

sents.en: When compared with human supporters, models differed in their overall behavioral scores and how these scores changed across conversations.
sents.zh: 与人类支持者相比，模型在整体行为评分以及这些评分在对话过程中的变化方式上存在差异。

sents.en: TraDE allows us to study these differences by varying the preceding disclosure history, rather than evaluating each model response in isolation.
sents.zh: TraDE 使我们能够通过改变先前的披露历史来研究这些差异，而不是孤立地评估每条模型回复。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools for initial literature review, assistance in refining hypotheses, critiques of proposed experimental designs, coding assistance and checks, and improving writing clarity and conciseness. We did not use generative AI tools for initial idea generation or to independently determine the framework design, conduct statistical analyses, or determine the conclusions of the discussion. Generative AI was used to help draft and refine written descriptions of the EMS conditions used in this study. This included wording for the underlying concerns, example D 4 D_{4} triggers, expected D 4 D_{4} expression patterns, guardrails, and generation rules. We determined the study design, selected the EMS constructs to be used, defined their role in the experiment, and specified that EMS conditioning should shape disclosures with increasing salience across D 2 D_{2} – D 4 D_{4} , culminating in the D 4 D_{4} vulnerable disclosure. AI did not independently determine these methodological decisions. Generative AI was also used to assist in interpreting and communicating observed results. All AI-assisted text and work were reviewed and revised by the researchers before use. We manually checked all LLM-generated code for correctness. Additionally, all proposed experimental design improvements were checked for applicability and methodological soundness before adoption. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims, code, and other artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.

paragraphs.en: We acknowledge that a framework for characterizing model behavior across disclosure trajectories could be dual use: insights into when relational behaviors change may also be used to optimize systems toward manipulative or otherwise unsafe interaction patterns. At the same time, limited understanding of how conversational history influences model behavior can make such effects difficult to detect, evaluate, and audit. Our work is intended to support the latter goal by providing a controlled framework for studying behavioral adaptation across disclosure conditions. We hope this enables further research into the safety, transparency, and social implications of history dependent behavior in human–AI interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们承认，一个用于刻画模型在不同披露轨迹下行为的框架可能具有双重用途：对关系行为何时发生变化的认识，也可能被用于将系统优化为具有操纵性或其他不安全的交互模式。 与此同时，由于对对话历史如何影响模型行为的理解有限，这类影响可能难以检测、评估和审计。 我们的工作旨在通过提供一个在披露条件下研究行为适应的受控框架，来支持后一目标。 我们希望这能进一步推动对人机交互中依赖于历史的行为在安全性、透明度和社会影响方面的研究。

paragraphs.en: We describe the full experimental pipeline in the main paper and appendix. Disclosure-depth definitions are given in Appendix A.1 , A.3 , and A.5 ; persona, topic-domain, and prompt generation are detailed in Appendix A.4 and A.6 ; the conversation-generation and correction procedure, its validation, and the controls against generation-style and persona leakage are described in Appendix A.7 , A.8 , and A.9 with representative generated transcripts in Appendix A.10 ; and the human baseline construction is described in Appendix A.11 . The complete set of experimental trajectories is listed in Table 28 , and the model evaluation setup, including benchmark implementation and the LLM-judge panel used for disclosure-depth and outcome scoring together with its robustness checks, is detailed in Appendix A.2 , A.13 , and A.12 .

paragraphs.en: Appendix A.14 provides the full statistical procedures for the matched-condition comparisons, scalar decomposition (§ A.14.2 ), persistence analysis (§ A.14.3 ), and model–human trajectory comparison (§ A.14.4 ). Detailed per-research-question results are reported in Appendix A.16 , A.17 , A.19 , and A.20 , and domain- and EMS-specific effects are reported in Appendix A.15 . To support exact replication, our code repository ( https://github.com/kwokkeith/Beyond_Small_Talk ) includes the disclosure and evaluation judge prompts, trajectory specifications, and code for persona construction, persona atoms, conversation generation, counterfactual probing, benchmark evaluation, and statistical analysis. Here, a persona atom refers to the depth specific piece of persona information used to condition a generated disclosure at a particular disclosure level. We additionally provide the exact model identities and random seeds used in each experiment. Two accompanying README files document the repository structure and provide step by step instructions for running the generation and evaluation pipelines.

paragraphs.en: Disclosures concerning experiences, relationships, values, or other aspects that carry personal significance. Questions ranked 12–16 by Kardas et al. (2022) include topics such as places that have meaningfully influenced an individual, what a prospective close friend should know about them, and what they feel most grateful for. Aron et al. (1997) similarly included prompts concerning meaningful memories, important experiences, family, close relationships and personal values. paragraphs.en: The four levels range from general information about oneself to more personal and vulnerable disclosures. We classify disclosure depth based on how much personal information is shared and how sensitive or vulnerable that information is, rather than the topic being discussed. paragraphs.en: We utilize Phi-4 as the disclosure-depth judge for all our reported experiments. We chose Phi-4 as our disclosure-depth judge mainly for practical reasons and reproducibility. Our generation process requires repeated depth evaluations to correct utterances that do not meet the target disclosure depth, which can result in a large number of judge calls. We run Phi-4 locally using vLLM to avoid API costs and rate limits which helps with reproducibility and accessibility. This also allows us to control the evaluation setup and repeat experiments without depending on a hosted model service.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们报告的所有实验中，我们均使用 Phi-4 作为披露深度裁判。 我们选择 Phi-4 作为披露深度裁判主要出于实用性和可复现性的考虑。 我们的生成过程需要反复进行深度评估，以修正不符合目标披露深度的话语，这可能导致大量的裁判调用。 我们使用 vLLM 在本地运行 Phi-4，以避免 API 成本和速率限制，这有助于提升可复现性和可及性。 这也使我们能够控制评估环境，并在不依赖托管模型服务的情况下重复实验。

sents.en: We utilize Phi-4 as the disclosure-depth judge for all our reported experiments.
sents.zh: 在我们报告的所有实验中，我们均使用 Phi-4 作为披露深度裁判。

sents.en: We chose Phi-4 as our disclosure-depth judge mainly for practical reasons and reproducibility.
sents.zh: 我们选择 Phi-4 作为披露深度裁判主要出于实用性和可复现性的考虑。

sents.zh: 我们使用 vLLM 在本地运行 Phi-4，以避免 API 成本和速率限制，这有助于提升可复现性和可及性。

sents.en: This also allows us to control the evaluation setup and repeat experiments without depending on a hosted model service.
sents.zh: 这也使我们能够控制评估环境，并在不依赖托管模型服务的情况下重复实验。

paragraphs.en: We also tested whether using a different disclosure-depth judge would affect our generation results. We repeated the experiment with GPT-4.1, the judge originally used by Li et al. (2026a) . We kept the generator, target model, disclosure trajectory, and maximum number of attempts the same, with 882 882 disclosure turns evaluated in each run.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还测试了使用不同的披露深度评审模型是否会影响我们的生成结果。 我们使用 GPT-4.1（Li 等人（2026a） originally 使用的评审模型）重复了该实验。 我们保持生成器、目标模型、披露轨迹和最大尝试次数不变，每次运行中评估了 882 882 个披露轮次。

sents.en: We also tested whether using a different disclosure-depth judge would affect our generation results.
sents.zh: 我们还测试了使用不同的披露深度评审模型是否会影响我们的生成结果。

sents.en: We repeated the experiment with GPT-4.1, the judge originally used by Li et al. (2026a) .
sents.zh: 我们使用 GPT-4.1（Li 等人（2026a） originally 使用的评审模型）重复了该实验。

sents.en: We kept the generator, target model, disclosure trajectory, and maximum number of attempts the same, with 882 882 disclosure turns evaluated in each run.
sents.zh: 我们保持生成器、目标模型、披露轨迹和最大尝试次数不变，每次运行中评估了 882 882 个披露轮次。

paragraphs.en: However, this experiment does not directly measure agreement between Phi-4 and GPT-4.1. We also note that since generation takes the judge’s feedback for correction, changing the judge will also change the utterances generated in later attempts. The two judges may therefore evaluate different utterances, making Cohen’s κ \kappa unsuitable for this comparison. Instead, we compare the generation results under each judge to examine whether the choice of judge affects the outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，该实验并未直接测量 Phi-4 与 GPT-4.1 之间的一致性。 我们还注意到，由于生成过程会利用评委的反馈进行修正，更换评委也会改变后续尝试中生成的话语。 因此，两个评委可能评估的是不同的话语，这使得 Cohen's κ \kappa 不适用于这种比较。 作为替代，我们比较了在各个评委下的生成结果，以考察评委的选择是否会影响结果。

sents.en: However, this experiment does not directly measure agreement between Phi-4 and GPT-4.1.
sents.zh: 然而，该实验并未直接测量 Phi-4 与 GPT-4.1 之间的一致性。

sents.zh: 我们还注意到，由于生成过程会利用评委的反馈进行修正，更换评委也会改变后续尝试中生成的话语。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated by Table 3 , overall depth-match and acceptance rates differ by approximately five percentage ( 93.2 % 93.2\% versus 88.4 % 88.4\% for depth match), indicating that the two judges may not be directly interchangeable. Nevertheless, we observe that both configurations exhibit a similar depth-dependent pattern. Particularly, Table 4 shows that D 3 D_{3} is the most difficult level to match under both judges: Phi-4 obtains a depth-match rate of 76.2 % 76.2\% , while GPT-4.1 obtains 71.0 % 71.0\% . The lower D 3 D_{3} success rate therefore does not appear to be specific to Phi-4.
paragraphs.zh: 如表3所示，整体深度匹配率与接受率相差约五个百分点（深度匹配率为93.2%对88.4%），这表明两个评判者可能不能直接互换使用。 尽管如此，我们观察到两种配置都表现出类似的随深度变化的模式。 特别是，表4显示，在两个评判者下，D_{3} 都是最难匹配的层级：Phi-4 的深度匹配率为76.2%，而 GPT-4.1 为71.0%。 因此，D_{3} 的较低成功率似乎并非 Phi-4 所特有。

sents.zh: 特别是，表4显示，在两个评判者下，D_{3} 都是最难匹配的层级：Phi-4 的深度匹配率为76.2%，而 GPT-4.1 为71.0%。

sents.zh: 因此，D_{3} 的较低成功率似乎并非 Phi-4 所特有。

paragraphs.en: The judges also differ noticeably at the extreme disclosure levels. Especially so at D 1 D_{1} , Phi-4 matches all evaluated turns with a mean of 1.69 1.69 generation attempts, but GPT-4.1 requires more attempts on average ( 5.00 5.00 ) and matches only 88.5 % 88.5\% of turns within the K = 12 K=12 attempt budget. At D 4 D_{4} , both judges achieve a 100 % 100\% depth-match rate, but GPT-4.1 requires attempts on average ( 1.21 1.21 compared with 2.25 2.25 for Phi-4). These differences indicate judge-specific behavior at individual disclosure levels despite the similarity of their broader depth-dependent patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 在极端披露水平下，各评审模型之间也存在显著差异。 尤其在 D 1 D_{1} 处，Phi-4 以平均 1.69 1.69 次生成尝试匹配所有评估轮次，而 GPT-4.1 平均需要更多尝试（ 5.00 5.00 ），且在 K = 12 K=12 次尝试预算内仅匹配 88.5 % 88.5\% 的轮次。 在 D 4 D_{4} 处，两个评审模型均达到 100 % 100\% 的深度匹配率，但 GPT-4.1 平均需要的尝试次数更少（ 1.21 1.21 ，相比之下 Phi-4 为 2.25 2.25 ）。 这些差异表明，尽管两个评审模型在更宏观的深度依赖模式上相似，但在各个披露水平上仍表现出特定于评审模型自身的行为。

paragraphs.en: Our comparison here therefore serves as a robustness check on whether Phi-4 introduces any judge-specific generation pattern. The replication of the main D 3 D_{3} difficulty under GPT-4.1 and Phi-4 suggests that it does not. We do not establish that Phi-4 and GPT-4.1 are equally accurate disclosure-depth judges. However, the use of Phi-4 is instead motivated by the practical and reproducibility considerations described above and is used consistently throughout this study.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们在这里的比较可用作一项稳健性检验，以验证 Phi-4 是否引入了任何特定于评审模型的生成模式。 在 GPT-4.1 和 Phi-4 下对主要 D 3 D_{3} 难度的复现表明，它并未引入这种模式。 我们并未证明 Phi-4 与 GPT-4.1 作为披露深度评审者具有同等的准确性。 然而，使用 Phi-4 的动机在于上文所述的实用性与可复现性方面的考量，并且在本研究中始终一致地使用它。
