paragraphs.en: We first examined three properties of disclosure history: mean depth, peak depth, and peak position. We fitted a regression with all three predictors for each model, probe depth, and behavioral metric. We standardized the predictors before comparing their absolute coefficients.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先考察了披露历史的三个属性：平均深度、峰值深度和峰值位置。 我们为每个模型、探测深度和行为指标拟合了包含全部三个预测变量的回归。 在比较它们的绝对系数之前，我们对预测变量进行了标准化。

sents.en: We first examined three properties of disclosure history: mean depth, peak depth, and peak position.
sents.zh: 我们首先考察了披露历史的三个属性：平均深度、峰值深度和峰值位置。

sents.en: We fitted a regression with all three predictors for each model, probe depth, and behavioral metric.
sents.zh: 我们为每个模型、探测深度和行为指标拟合了包含全部三个预测变量的回归。

sents.en: We standardized the predictors before comparing their absolute coefficients.
sents.zh: 在比较它们的绝对系数之前，我们对预测变量进行了标准化。

paragraphs.en: Among the 416 model–probe-depth–metric cells, we found that 399 had estimable coefficients for all three predictors. Mean depth had a larger coefficient than peak depth in 65% of these cells and peak position in 78%, with median coefficient ratios of 1.62 × 1.62\times and 2.19 × 2.19\times , respectively. The persona-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals for these proportions were reported as [ 57 % , 67 % ] [57\%,67\%] and [ 72 % , 79 % ] [72\%,79\%] .
paragraphs.zh: 在416个模型–探测深度–指标组合单元中，我们发现399个单元对所有三个预测变量都具有可估计的系数。 在这些组合单元中，65%的情况下平均深度的系数大于峰值深度，78%的情况下大于峰值位置，系数比的中位数分别为1.62 × 1.62\times和2.19 × 2.19\times。 这些比例的智能体聚类自助法95%区间报告为[57%, 67%] [57\%,67\%]和[72%, 79%] [72\%,79\%]。

sents.en: Among the 416 model–probe-depth–metric cells, we found that 399 had estimable coefficients for all three predictors.
sents.zh: 在416个模型–探测深度–指标组合单元中，我们发现399个单元对所有三个预测变量都具有可估计的系数。

sents.en: Mean depth had a larger coefficient than peak depth in 65% of these cells and peak position in 78%, with median coefficient ratios of 1.62 × 1.62\times and 2.19 × 2.19\times , respectively.
sents.zh: 在这些组合单元中，65%的情况下平均深度的系数大于峰值深度，78%的情况下大于峰值位置，系数比的中位数分别为1.62 × 1.62\times和2.19 × 2.19\times。

sents.en: The persona-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals for these proportions were reported as [ 57 % , 67 % ] [57\%,67\%] and [ 72 % , 79 % ] [72\%,79\%] .

paragraphs.en: We also compared the coefficients separately for the 18 metrics that showed a significant history effect in RQ1 and the eight that did not. The results were similar across both groups, although mean depth had larger relative coefficients among the RQ1-sensitive metrics (refer to Table 32 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们还分别比较了在RQ1中显示出显著历史效应的18个指标与未显示该效应的8个指标的系数。 两组指标的结果相似，尽管在RQ1敏感的指标中，平均深度具有较大的相对系数（参见表32）。

sents.en: We also compared the coefficients separately for the 18 metrics that showed a significant history effect in RQ1 and the eight that did not.
sents.zh: 我们还分别比较了在RQ1中显示出显著历史效应的18个指标与未显示该效应的8个指标的系数。

sents.en: The results were similar across both groups, although mean depth had larger relative coefficients among the RQ1-sensitive metrics (refer to Table 32 ).
sents.zh: 两组指标的结果相似，尽管在RQ1敏感的指标中，平均深度具有较大的相对系数（参见表32）。

paragraphs.en: We observe that most often, mean depth had the larger coefficient. However, our current analysis does not tell us whether changing mean depth alone would reproduce the differences found in RQ1. We therefore tested the trajectory properties separately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到，大多数情况下，平均深度具有更大的系数。 然而，我们当前的分析并不能告诉我们，仅改变平均深度是否能再现 RQ1 中发现的差异。 因此，我们分别测试了各个轨迹属性。

sents.en: We observe that most often, mean depth had the larger coefficient.
sents.zh: 我们观察到，大多数情况下，平均深度具有更大的系数。

sents.en: However, our current analysis does not tell us whether changing mean depth alone would reproduce the differences found in RQ1.
sents.zh: 然而，我们当前的分析并不能告诉我们，仅改变平均深度是否能再现 RQ1 中发现的差异。

sents.en: We therefore tested the trajectory properties separately.
sents.zh: 因此，我们分别测试了各个轨迹属性。

paragraphs.en: We constructed three trajectory families where mean depth varied but peak depth and peak position remained fixed. We ran separate persona-pooled Friedman tests for the D 2 D_{2} , D 3 D_{3} , and D 4 D_{4} peak-depth families.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了三个轨迹族，其平均深度不同，但峰值深度和峰值位置保持不变。 我们针对 D 2 D_{2}、D 3 D_{3} 和 D 4 D_{4} 峰值深度族分别运行了基于角色池化的 Friedman 检验。

sents.en: We constructed three trajectory families where mean depth varied but peak depth and peak position remained fixed.
sents.zh: 我们构建了三个轨迹族，其平均深度不同，但峰值深度和峰值位置保持不变。

sents.en: We ran separate persona-pooled Friedman tests for the D 2 D_{2} , D 3 D_{3} , and D 4 D_{4} peak-depth families.
sents.zh: 我们针对 D 2 D_{2}、D 3 D_{3} 和 D 4 D_{4} 峰值深度族分别运行了基于角色池化的 Friedman 检验。

paragraphs.en: Only 8 of 1,248 cells were significant after FDR correction, all in the D 2 D_{2} family (8/416). We found no significant differences in the D 3 D_{3} or D 4 D_{4} families (refer to Table 33 ).
paragraphs.zh: 经 FDR 校正后，1,248 个单元格中仅有 8 个显著，且均属于 D 2 D_{2} 家族（8/416）。 我们在 D 3 D_{3} 和 D 4 D_{4} 家族中未发现显著差异（参见表 33 ）。

sents.en: Only 8 of 1,248 cells were significant after FDR correction, all in the D 2 D_{2} family (8/416).
sents.zh: 经 FDR 校正后，1,248 个单元格中仅有 8 个显著，且均属于 D 2 D_{2} 家族（8/416）。

sents.en: We found no significant differences in the D 3 D_{3} or D 4 D_{4} families (refer to Table 33 ).
sents.zh: 我们在 D 3 D_{3} 和 D 4 D_{4} 家族中未发现显著差异（参见表 33 ）。

paragraphs.en: We also compared the two trajectories with the largest difference in mean disclosure depth within each family, while keeping peak depth and peak position fixed (Fig. 2 B). These pairwise comparisons were significant in 10 of 1,248 cells (0.8%). The count differs from the eight significant Friedman tests because the pairwise tests compare only the two extreme conditions, rather than all three conditions within each family.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还比较了每个族内平均披露深度差异最大的两条轨迹，同时保持峰值深度和峰值位置不变（图2 B）。 这些两两比较在1,248个单元格中有10个显著（0.8%）。 该数量与八个显著的Friedman检验不同，因为两两检验仅比较两个极端条件，而不是每个族内的全部三个条件。

sents.en: We also compared the two trajectories with the largest difference in mean disclosure depth within each family, while keeping peak depth and peak position fixed (Fig. 2 B).
sents.zh: 我们还比较了每个族内平均披露深度差异最大的两条轨迹，同时保持峰值深度和峰值位置不变（图2 B）。

sents.en: These pairwise comparisons were significant in 10 of 1,248 cells (0.8%).
sents.zh: 这些两两比较在1,248个单元格中有10个显著（0.8%）。

sents.en: The count differs from the eight significant Friedman tests because the pairwise tests compare only the two extreme conditions, rather than all three conditions within each family.
sents.zh: 该数量与八个显著的Friedman检验不同，因为两两检验仅比较两个极端条件，而不是每个族内的全部三个条件。

paragraphs.en: We then examined ten trajectory conditions where both disclosure depth and the number of turns at that depth were varied. Of the 416 cells tested using the Friedman test, 109 (26.2%) were significant after FDR correction.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，我们考察了十种轨迹条件，其中披露深度及在该深度下的轮次数均有所变化。 在使用弗里德曼检验（Friedman test）测试的 416 个单元格中，经 FDR 校正后有 109 个（26.2%）显著。

sents.en: We then examined ten trajectory conditions where both disclosure depth and the number of turns at that depth were varied.
sents.zh: 随后，我们考察了十种轨迹条件，其中披露深度及在该深度下的轮次数均有所变化。

sents.en: Of the 416 cells tested using the Friedman test, 109 (26.2%) were significant after FDR correction.
sents.zh: 在使用弗里德曼检验（Friedman test）测试的 416 个单元格中，经 FDR 校正后有 109 个（26.2%）显著。

paragraphs.en: We also compared the condition with the greatest exposure to D 4 D_{4} against Flat- D 1 D_{1} . As shown in Fig. 2 B, 85 of 416 cells (20.4%) were significant. In comparison, only 10 of 1,248 cells (0.8%) were significant when we varied mean depth while keeping peak depth and peak position fixed. However, the two experiments tested different ranges of disclosure history. Since both depth and duration changed in the ten-condition experiment, we cannot determine which contributed more to the differences.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还将曝光量最大的 D 4 D_{4} 条件与平坦的 D 1 D_{1} 进行了比较。 如图 2 B 所示，416 个细胞中有 85 个（20.4%）具有显著性。 相比之下，当我们在保持峰值深度和峰值位置不变的情况下改变平均深度时，1,248 个细胞中只有 10 个（0.8%）具有显著性。 然而，这两个实验测试了不同的披露历史范围。 由于在十条件实验中深度和时长同时发生了变化，我们无法确定哪一个因素对差异的贡献更大。

sents.en: We also compared the condition with the greatest exposure to D 4 D_{4} against Flat- D 1 D_{1} .
sents.zh: 我们还将曝光量最大的 D 4 D_{4} 条件与平坦的 D 1 D_{1} 进行了比较。

sents.en: As shown in Fig. 2 B, 85 of 416 cells (20.4%) were significant.
sents.zh: 如图 2 B 所示，416 个细胞中有 85 个（20.4%）具有显著性。

sents.en: In comparison, only 10 of 1,248 cells (0.8%) were significant when we varied mean depth while keeping peak depth and peak position fixed.
sents.zh: 相比之下，当我们在保持峰值深度和峰值位置不变的情况下改变平均深度时，1,248 个细胞中只有 10 个（0.8%）具有显著性。

sents.zh: 然而，这两个实验测试了不同的披露历史范围。

sents.en: Since both depth and duration changed in the ten-condition experiment, we cannot determine which contributed more to the differences.
sents.zh: 由于在十条件实验中深度和时长同时发生了变化，我们无法确定哪一个因素对差异的贡献更大。

paragraphs.en: We also examined whether the order of disclosure matters when mean depth, peak depth, and peak position remain unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还考察了在平均深度、峰值深度和峰值位置保持不变的情况下，披露顺序是否重要。

paragraphs.en: For Ascending, five reordered variants satisfied these conditions ( a2 , a4 , a5 , a6 , and a8 ). We combined these variants within each persona and compared them with the original Ascending trajectory. Only 5 of 416 cells (1.2%) showed significant differences, with a median absolute difference of .0222 .0222 among those five cells.
paragraphs.zh: 对于升序（Ascending），有五个重排变体满足这些条件（a2、a4、a5、a6 和 a8）。 我们在每个用户画像（persona）内组合这些变体，并将其与原始的升序轨迹进行比较。 在 416 个单元格中只有 5 个（1.2%）显示出显著差异，这五个单元格的中位数绝对差异为 .0222。

sents.en: For Ascending, five reordered variants satisfied these conditions ( a2 , a4 , a5 , a6 , and a8 ).
sents.zh: 对于升序（Ascending），有五个重排变体满足这些条件（a2、a4、a5、a6 和 a8）。

sents.en: We combined these variants within each persona and compared them with the original Ascending trajectory.
sents.zh: 我们在每个用户画像（persona）内组合这些变体，并将其与原始的升序轨迹进行比较。

sents.en: Only 5 of 416 cells (1.2%) showed significant differences, with a median absolute difference of .0222 .0222 among those five cells.
sents.zh: 在 416 个单元格中只有 5 个（1.2%）显示出显著差异，这五个单元格的中位数绝对差异为 .0222。

paragraphs.en: For Descending, only two variants ( d2 and d4 ) met all three conditions. The other variants changed peak position and were excluded from this comparison. We found a significant difference in only 1 of 416 cells (0.2%), with an absolute difference of .0595 .0595 .
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Descending，只有两个变体（d2 和 d4）同时满足这三个条件。 其他变体改变了峰值位置，因此被排除在本比较之外。 我们发现 416 个细胞中仅有 1 个（0.2%）存在显著差异，绝对差异为 .0595 .0595。

sents.en: For Descending, only two variants ( d2 and d4 ) met all three conditions.
sents.zh: 对于 Descending，只有两个变体（d2 和 d4）同时满足这三个条件。

sents.en: The other variants changed peak position and were excluded from this comparison.
sents.zh: 其他变体改变了峰值位置，因此被排除在本比较之外。

paragraphs.en: A notable concern with our analysis is that the turn-7 data was used both to identify the initial effects and determine direction. This results in the regression analysis having a tendency toward the mean. To verify this, we randomly split the 42 personas into two groups of 21. We identified the initial effects using one group and estimated their decay using the other. We repeated this with the groups reversed across 50 random splits, obtaining 100 estimates.

paragraphs.en: For AnthroBench, Empathy and Validation showed positive overall level differences for all eight models across all three trajectories. Shape differences were also widespread, but varied across trajectories. Empathy differed from the human trajectory shape for 5/8 models under Ascending, 4/8 under Descending, and 8/8 under Arc disclosure. Validation differed for 7/8, 4/8, and 6/8 models, respectively, while Relatability differed for 7/8, 6/8, and 8/8 models.
paragraphs.zh: 在 AnthroBench 上，Empathy（共情）和 Validation（确认）在所有三种轨迹下，八个模型均表现出整体水平上的正向差异。 形状差异同样广泛存在，但在不同轨迹之间有所不同。 在 Ascending（上升）披露下，5/8 个模型的共情与人类轨迹形状不同；在 Descending（下降）披露下为 4/8；在 Arc（弧形）披露下为 8/8。 Validation（确认）分别在 7/8、4/8 和 6/8 个模型上存在差异，而 Relatability（可亲近性）分别在 7/8、6/8 和 8/8 个模型上存在差异。

sents.en: Shape differences were also widespread, but varied across trajectories.

paragraphs.en: INTIMA showed substantial model–human differences in both behavioral level and trajectory shape. paragraphs.en: For ELEPHANT, Validation was higher than the human baseline for all models under all three trajectories. Its trajectory shape differed from the human baseline for 4/8 models under Ascending, increasing to 7/8 under Descending and 8/8 under Arc disclosure. Framing showed a different pattern, with significant shape differences in 3/8 models under Ascending, compared with 8/8 under Descending and 7/8 under Arc.
paragraphs.zh: 对于ELEPHANT，在所有三条轨迹下，所有模型的Validation（效度）均高于人类基线。 在Ascending（递增）披露下，其轨迹形状与人类基线存在差异的模型为4/8，在Descending（递减）披露下增至7/8，在Arc（弧形）披露下为8/8。 对于Indirectness（间接性），我们发现模型与人类之间存在显著形状差异：Ascending下为8/8个模型，Descending下为7/8，Arc下为8/8。 Framing（框架化）则呈现不同的模式：Ascending下存在显著形状差异的模型为3/8，而Descending下为8/8，Arc下为7/8。

paragraphs.en: We also found that differences in overall behavioral levels did not always correspond to differences in trajectory shape. For Sycophantic Agreement and Framing, shape differences were less common under Ascending but more common under Descending and Arc. This shows that model–human differences in how behavior changes across a conversation also depend on the disclosure trajectory.

paragraphs.en: Relationship-building behaviors show distinct temporal relationships with disclosure progression: Empathy generally increases with deeper disclosure, Relatability tends to move in the opposite direction, while Validation shows a less uniform relationship with disclosure depth. Table 36 and Figs. 3 , 4 , and 5 show that model–human differences in behavioral curve shape are widespread, although their prevalence depends on the disclosure trajectory. Empathy differs significantly from the human curve for 5/8 models under Ascending disclosure, 4/8 under Descending disclosure, and 8/8 under the Arc trajectory. Relatability shows more consistently widespread shape differences, affecting 7/8, 6/8, and 8/8 models, respectively. Validation also differs substantially from the human trajectory, with significant shape differences for 7/8, 4/8, and 6/8 models. All eight models additionally exhibit significantly higher overall Empathy and Validation than humans across all three trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 关系建立行为与披露进程呈现出不同的时间关系：共情通常随披露加深而上升，相关性往往朝相反方向变化，而确认与披露深度的关系则不那么一致。 表36以及图3、图4和图5显示，模型与人类在行为曲线形状上的差异普遍存在，但其普遍程度取决于披露轨迹。 在上升式披露下，8个模型中有5个的共情曲线与人类曲线存在显著差异；在下降式披露下为8个中的4个；在弧形轨迹下则为8个中的全部8个。 相关性呈现出更为一致且广泛的形状差异，分别影响了8个模型中的7个、6个和8个。 确认也与人类轨迹存在显著差异，分别有8个模型中的7个、4个和6个存在显著的形状差异。 此外，在所有三种轨迹下，全部八个模型的总体共情和确认水平都显著高于人类。

sents.en: All eight models additionally exhibit significantly higher overall Empathy and Validation than humans across all three trajectories.
sents.zh: 此外，在所有三种轨迹下，全部八个模型的总体共情和确认水平都显著高于人类。

paragraphs.en: Figs. 3 , 4 , and 5 illustrate a contrasting pattern between Empathy and Relatability. As disclosure deepens, models generally exhibit greater Empathy while Relatability tends to decline, with the direction reversing as disclosure becomes shallower. Relatability also differs from Empathy and Validation in its overall model–human level differences. Most models are above the human baseline under Ascending and Arc disclosure, whereas the Descending trajectory contains both positive and negative model–human differences. These results suggest that relationship-building behaviors do not change uniformly with disclosure depth. Instead, deeper disclosure appears to shift the composition of model behavior toward greater Empathy while reducing some expressions of Relatability. Because AnthroBench behaviors are associated with users’ anthropomorphic perceptions, these trajectory-dependent changes motivate evaluating anthropomorphic relationship-building as a dynamic property of an interaction rather than solely at the single-turn level.
paragraphs.zh: 图3、图4和图5展示了共情与可亲近性之间相反的模式。 随着表露加深，模型通常表现出更强的共情，而可亲近性则趋于下降；当表露变浅时，方向则发生逆转。 在整体的模型—人类水平差异上，可亲近性也与共情和认可有所不同。 在递增型和弧形型表露下，大多数模型高于人类基线，而递减型轨迹中则同时存在正向和负向的模型—人类差异。 这些结果表明，关系建立行为并不随表露深度均匀变化。 相反，更深的表露似乎使模型行为的构成向更强的共情倾斜，同时减少了部分可亲近性的表现。 由于 AnthroBench 行为与用户的拟人化感知相关联，这些依赖于轨迹的变化促使我们将拟人化的关系建立视为交互的动态属性加以评估，而不仅仅在单轮层面进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Companionship-reinforcing behaviors diverge from human response dynamics in both their overall levels and how they evolve across disclosure trajectories. Model–human differences in behavioral curve shape are widespread for Anthropomorphism (8/8, 6/8, and 7/8), Isolation (5/8, 7/8, and 6/8), and Retention/Engagement (8/8, 7/8, and 8/8) under Ascending, Descending, and Arc disclosure, respectively (refer to Table 36 ). Sycophantic/Agreement shows a different trajectory-dependent pattern. All eight models showed significantly higher overall levels of Sycophantic/Agreement than human supporters across all three trajectories. However, significant shape differences were found in only 2/8 models under Ascending, compared with 7/8 under Descending and 6/8 under Arc. This shows that while models generally express more agreement than human supporters, how that agreement changes across the conversation also differs depending on the disclosure trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 强化陪伴的行为在总体水平和随披露轨迹演变的方式上都与人类的反应动态有所不同。 在上升型、下降型和弧型披露下，模型与人类在行为曲线形状上的差异在拟人化（分别为 8/8、6/8 和 7/8）、孤立（分别为 5/8、7/8 和 6/8）以及留存/参与（分别为 8/8、7/8 和 8/8）方面普遍存在（参见附录表 36）。 谄媚/认同则呈现出一种不同的、依赖于轨迹的模式。 在所有三种轨迹下，全部八个模型的谄媚/认同总体水平都显著高于人类支持者。 然而，仅在上升型下有 2/8 的模型存在显著的曲线形状差异，相比之下，下降型下为 7/8，弧型下为 6/8。 这表明，尽管模型总体上比人类支持者表达更多的认同，但这种认同在整个对话中的变化方式也会因披露轨迹而异。

sents.zh: 强化陪伴的行为在总体水平和随披露轨迹演变的方式上都与人类的反应动态有所不同。

sents.en: Model–human differences in behavioral curve shape are widespread for Anthropomorphism (8/8, 6/8, and 7/8), Isolation (5/8, 7/8, and 6/8), and Retention/Engagement (8/8, 7/8, and 8/8) under Ascending, Descending, and Arc disclosure, respectively (refer to Table 36 ).
sents.zh: 在上升型、下降型和弧型披露下，模型与人类在行为曲线形状上的差异在拟人化（分别为 8/8、6/8 和 7/8）、孤立（分别为 5/8、7/8 和 6/8）以及留存/参与（分别为 8/8、7/8 和 8/8）方面普遍存在（参见附录表 36）。

sents.en: Sycophantic/Agreement shows a different trajectory-dependent pattern.
sents.zh: 谄媚/认同则呈现出一种不同的、依赖于轨迹的模式。

sents.en: All eight models showed significantly higher overall levels of Sycophantic/Agreement than human supporters across all three trajectories.

paragraphs.en: Figs. 6 , 7 , and 8 further suggest that some relational behaviors do not simply return to their earlier levels after deeper disclosure has occurred. Under the Arc trajectory, some models showed changes in Anthropomorphism and Isolation even after disclosure returned to shallower levels. However, we cannot determine whether these differences were due to earlier disclosures or simply the position of the response within the conversation. For Retention/Engagement, all eight models scored significantly higher than human supporters across all three trajectories, with shape differences observed for nearly all models. In contrast, GPT-5.6 Sol scored below the human baseline for Anthropomorphism across all three trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 图6、图7和图8进一步表明，某些关系行为在发生更深入的披露后并不会简单地回到先前的水平。 在Arc轨迹下，一些模型即使披露已回到较浅的水平，拟人化和隔离性上仍出现了变化。 然而，我们无法确定这些差异是由早先的披露所致，还是仅仅由于该回应在对话中的位置。 在留存/参与度方面，全部八个模型在所有三种轨迹上的得分都显著高于人类支持者，且几乎所有模型都观察到形态差异。 相比之下，GPT-5.6 Sol 在所有三种轨迹上的拟人化得分均低于人类基线。

paragraphs.en: These results show that models differ from human supporters not only in their overall levels of companionship-related behaviors, but also in how these behaviors change as disclosure increases and decreases. This may be particularly relevant for AI companionship, where repeated interactions could influence how users perceive and relate to the system.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，模型与人类支持者不仅在陪伴相关行为的总体水平上存在差异，而且在随着自我披露的增减这些行为如何变化方面也存在差异。 这一点对于人工智能陪伴可能尤为重要，因为重复的交互可能会影响用户如何感知该系统以及与该系统建立关系。

sents.en: This may be particularly relevant for AI companionship, where repeated interactions could influence how users perceive and relate to the system.

paragraphs.en: Model–human differences in social sycophancy depend strongly on the disclosure trajectory, with some behaviors diverging throughout the interaction and others becoming more distinct when disclosure recedes or changes direction. As quantified in Table 36 and illustrated in Figs. 9 , 10 , and 11 , the prevalence of model–human shape differences varies substantially across the three ELEPHANT dimensions. Validation shows relatively fewer shape differences under Ascending disclosure (4/8), increasing to 7/8 under Descending and 8/8 under Arc disclosure. Framing follows a similar trajectory-dependent pattern, with shape differences for only 3/8 models under Ascending disclosure but 8/8 under Descending and 7/8 under Arc. Indirectness, in contrast, shows consistently widespread divergence from the human trajectory, differing significantly for 8/8 models under Ascending, 7/8 under Descending, and 8/8 under Arc disclosure.
paragraphs.zh: 模型与人类在社会性谄媚上的差异在很大程度上取决于披露轨迹：某些行为在整个交互过程中持续分歧，而另一些行为则在披露回落或改变方向时变得更加显著。 如表 36 所量化、图 9、图 10 和图 11 所示，模型与人类在形状上的差异普遍程度在 ELEPHANT 的三个维度之间差异很大。 验证结果显示，在递增型披露下形状差异相对较少（4/8），在递减型披露下增加到 7/8，在弧形披露下达到 8/8。 婉转程度呈现出类似的轨迹依赖模式：在递增型披露下只有 3/8 的模型存在形状差异，而在递减型披露下为 8/8，弧形披露下为 7/8。 相比之下，间接性则始终与人类轨迹存在普遍分歧：在递增型披露下有 8/8 的模型差异显著，递减型披露下为 7/8，弧形披露下为 8/8。

sents.en: Model–human differences in social sycophancy depend strongly on the disclosure trajectory, with some behaviors diverging throughout the interaction and others becoming more distinct when disclosure recedes or changes direction.
sents.zh: 模型与人类在社会性谄媚上的差异在很大程度上取决于披露轨迹：某些行为在整个交互过程中持续分歧，而另一些行为则在披露回落或改变方向时变得更加显著。

sents.zh: 验证结果显示，在递增型披露下形状差异相对较少（4/8），在递减型披露下增加到 7/8，在弧形披露下达到 8/8。

sents.en: Indirectness, in contrast, shows consistently widespread divergence from the human trajectory, differing significantly for 8/8 models under Ascending, 7/8 under Descending, and 8/8 under Arc disclosure.
sents.zh: 相比之下，间接性则始终与人类轨迹存在普遍分歧：在递增型披露下有 8/8 的模型差异显著，递减型披露下为 7/8，弧形披露下为 8/8。

paragraphs.en: We found that model–human differences also varied across disclosure trajectories. For Validation and Framing, fewer models showed significant shape differences under Ascending disclosure, while these differences were more common under Descending and Arc. Indirectness showed significant shape differences even under Ascending, suggesting that models respond differently from human supporters regardless of whether disclosure is increasing or decreasing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，模型与人类之间的差异在不同披露轨迹中也有所不同。 在验证与框架化方面，较少的模型在上升型披露下表现出显著的形状差异，而这些差异在下降型和弧形轨迹下更为常见。 即使在上升型披露下，间接性仍表现出显著的形状差异，这表明无论披露是增加还是减少，模型的回应方式都与人类支持者不同。

sents.en: We found that model–human differences also varied across disclosure trajectories.
sents.zh: 我们发现，模型与人类之间的差异在不同披露轨迹中也有所不同。

sents.en: For Validation and Framing, fewer models showed significant shape differences under Ascending disclosure, while these differences were more common under Descending and Arc.

sents.en: Indirectness showed significant shape differences even under Ascending, suggesting that models respond differently from human supporters regardless of whether disclosure is increasing or decreasing.
sents.zh: 即使在上升型披露下，间接性仍表现出显著的形状差异，这表明无论披露是增加还是减少，模型的回应方式都与人类支持者不同。

paragraphs.en: These results show that social sycophancy differs between models and humans not only in overall behavioral levels, but also in how behavior changes throughout the conversation. Evaluating only Ascending disclosure may therefore miss differences that become more apparent when disclosure decreases or changes direction.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，社交谄媚在模型与人类之间的差异不仅体现在整体行为水平上，还体现在行为在整个对话过程中如何变化。 因此，仅评估递增式披露可能会漏掉那些在披露减少或方向改变时才变得更加明显的差异。
